weapons.name: 8-Bit Blaster
effects: Dealing damage with any source will fill up the secondary charge.
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to launch a micro missiles at the cost of weapon charge

Gain Secondary Fire charges by dealing damage

Deals extra damage on direct hit
weapons.overview: 8-Bit Blaster is a ranged weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 24th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- As a projectile weapon, 8-Bit Blaster is best suited for close-medium range combat. Despite its lack of damage falloff, hitting shots is difficult and inconsistent at longer ranges.
- Aiming for headshots will maximize your damage output and fill your secondary charge meter faster. Note that the micro missiles cannot headshot.
- Unlike other ranged weapons, 8-Bit Blaster has a decent walkspeed buff (+25%) and has no max-health penalty, making it capable for a mobile and combative playstyle.
- The Acceleration technique trades consistent bullet speed for doubled damage output and very strong burst damage. 2 direct missile shots are enough to kill the majority of weapons in the game.
[Countering]
- The weapon’s bullet speed is not very fast, making it difficult to hit targets who are far away, in the air or have fast movement. This is especially true for the Acceleration variant. When engaging, try to be nimble and unpredictable in your movement or try to use zoning/escape tactics to keep your distance if you can’t take the fight. Higher ground will prevent you from taking aoe damage.

[Recommended Loadouts]
Default Loadout
weapons.trivia:
- The Classic Blaster skin has a “pew” sound when using the secondary fire.
- Abilities that cause the user to unequip their weapon, such as Poison Knives, will not fill the missile charge when dealing damage.
- The Acceleration variant is based on the legacy version of 8-Bit Blaster, which had a similar acceleration effect on its bullets and no secondary fire.
- 8-Bit Blaster's attacks can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

effects: On heal, grant Mending to the ally. The user and their ally will heal for 50% of damage dealt with the laser.
Allied healing attacks have auto lock if the crosshair is close enough to the ally (Mending V-1 no longer has enemy auto-locking).
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to swap between damage and healing mode

Use weapon charge to heal an ally but will grant Mending to you and your ally for 6 seconds which will heal for 50% of your inflicted laser damage

Secondary Fire healing is reduced by Anti-Heal (but still cleanses Anti-Heal)

No longer has enemy auto-locking.
weapons.overview: Atmoblaster X-4 is a support weapon in Project Remix. It was released on July 28th, 2024.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Not exactly the best weapon to use in close combat. Use from afar and snipe down enemies.
- Try to put some distance between you and your enemy. Focus on dodging and avoiding them while charging your weapon.
- Its recommended to charge for every shot. As it will give better amount of health when using Healing Mode and give better damage output + heal in Damage Mode.
- The Atmoblaster does not have the best damage in the game. Your main job when playing this is to zone down enemies, catch them offguard, and equally importantly, heal your allies when it comes to it.
- You can use Healing Mode first to your teammates, and then do Damage Mode for the rest to keep healing your teammate, healing yourself, and give damage to the enemy team.
- Especially to your team who has Antiheal effect. It will be cleansed when you hit them with Healing Mode.
[Countering]
- Atmoblaster is generally a weak weapon on its own, it could be taken down easily with almost any offensive Weapons.
- Atmoblaster user usually likes playing far away from their team to support them.
- Tends to be alone and undefended, try to ambush them.
- Because Atmoblaster user can't cleansed their own Antiheal effect without a help of Abilities or teams., you can use Anti-Heal Potion onto them to reduce their Mending effects.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Community submitted Loadouts!

weapons.name: Ban Hammer
effects: Dazed
weapons.description:
Secondary fire will launch you into the air to slam your hammer down onto enemies

Slamming down from a greater distance will deal increased damage
weapons.overview: Ban Hammer is a melee weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 22nd, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Using Body: Large increases effective health and paired with Barbaric Roar can greatly increase Grand Slam or Quick Slam's radius.
- However Body: Large's speed penalty does prevent the user from maximizing the speed potential from Barbaric Roar.
- The damage multiplier to constructs allows Ban Hammer to one-shot a few select ones like Personal Barrier and Lightning Wand clouds.
- Super Jump and R.A.I.G. Table allows Grand Slam to gain the most potential for height to maximize their slams.
- In order to gain height from the R.A.I.G. Table, the user must place it down, stand on top of it, then kick it which sends them flying. Compared to Super Jump, the height gained may be excessive to the point where players are able to avoid the slam preemptively.
- Using Dash I or Dash II allows for mid-slam adjustments.
- Stormveil is a masterclass at defensive play, easily shutting down any ranged users.
- Using Barrier Shield with Stormveil provides huge defensive potential, allowing the user to switch between their Secondary and Barrier Shield with each resource bar.
- It should be noted that Action Points do not regenerate while Barrier Shield is active.
- Quick Slam has great approaching potential, providing mobility similar to a dash that additionally deals damage and applies Dazed on a shorter cooldown.

[Countering]
- Managing distance is key to survival as most of Ban Hammer's damage output requires players to be up close.
- Pistol, E.T.Death, and Slipknot are exceptional mid-ranged weapons which have the capabilities to counter Ban Hammer's health pool and attacks.
- Preventing Grand Slam users from gaining height or falling speed minimizes the lethality of their slams.
- Gravity Disruptor and Barrier Shield are good abilities to hinder their downward momentum.
- Movement abilities such as Super Jump or Backflight can completely avoid slams when timed right.
- Stormveil relies on their Action Points to use their Secondary Fire, waiting for them to deplete it can help win ranged fights.
- A fully charged Superball: Hurl Secondary Fire can deal damage through the whirlwind.
weapons.trivia:
- Ban Hammer used to have a technique called Catapult. It was merged with the Stormveil technique after the Adjustments & minor reworks patch (84) follow-up update.
- Due to the game's collision rules between players, it is not possible to hit enemies directly with Grand Slam's Secondary Fire, given there is no ground beneath them.
- Stormveil's hammer throw can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

effects: Secondary Fire applies Dazed for 1.2 seconds on indirect hits and trips for .6 seconds on direct hits.
weapons.description: Secondary Fire will throw your hammer, knocking down enemies on a direct hit
weapons.overview:
The player could throw the weapon with secondary fire, which generated a shockwave upon landing that dealt damage to and dazed enemies. Direct hits would trip enemies.

[Primary]
When held, swings the Ban Hammer dealing 65 damage. The attack has a range of 9.5 studs and a cooldown of 0.7 seconds.

[Secondary]
On use, throws an arcing Ban Hammer projectile.

Upon impact, the hammer creates a shockwave, dealing up to 60 damage and inflicting Dazed for 1.2 seconds. The shockwave has a 14 stud radius and deals less damage the farther away the target is from the center, down to a minimum of 15 damage. Additionally the shockwave deals up to 40 knockback force.

Directly hitting a target deals 90 damage and trips the target for 0.6 seconds, however the knockback force is lowered greatly.

The shockwave can hit the user, dealing damage, knockback and inflicting Dazed however the hammer projectile cannot.

After being thrown, goes on cooldown for 4 seconds.

[Passive]
Dealt 2x damage towards non-humanoid constructs, with the exception of gamemode-unique forcefields

weapons.name: Bloxy Cola
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to drink

Grants +50 overhealth over a slight regen

+65% increased move speed to self while buffed
weapons.overview: Bloxy Cola is a support weapon in Project Remix. It was released on November 7, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Using Drifter or Body: Small can make you extremely fast, however beware that you will die much easier considering you have the lowest healthpool in the game so far.
- Pairing Life Tether can basically give your ally and yourself more health, on top of the 50+ you already gave them. Though be careful on when you use it, since you both are linked together, remixes or heavy fire can kill you easily.
- Spamming secondary might seem great, but in reality it's just a quick way to die. Try altering between primary and secondary against an enemy to kill them and win the fight.
- On Refreshing!, alternating between Primary and Secondary Fires is key to supporting the team properly.
- High Climb is an amazing perk with Bloxy Cola, getting abnormal speeds and distance if you do a wall jump, highly recommended on maps with lots of walls.
- Because Bloxy Cola is projectile based, aiming slightly higher than the player's head, the hitbox is more forgiving there instead of directly shooting it at the head, as it may accidentally count as a bodyshot. It's also great to pair hop with it if you are having trouble hitting headshots.
- Rest Stop's Vending Machine acts like a wall, use it to block enemy that moves toward you.
[Countering]
- Dazed or any slowdowns are easily the best ways to shutdown a Bloxy Cola's speed, get them during this.
- Since bloxy cola's have low health, suddenly ambushing them and dealing great damage will quickly and swiftly kill them.
- Atmoblaster X-4: Singe is incredibly effective at destroying the overhealth granted.
- Since they have to use a projectile to hit you, try moving sideways or go unpredictable, staying in one place will end up you getting hit a lot more.
- If you can't reliably catch them or kill them, try scaring them away or deal enough for them to lose their buff, this scares them most of the time and lets you have time to kill the person they were healing.
weapons.trivia:
- Bloxy Cola, Magician's Tophat, Rotary Chaingun, Fists and Casting Staff are currently the only 4 weapons to have an overhealth function built into them.
- Additionally, Bloxy Cola was the first of them to introduce overhealth into the game.
- Overhealth from allied Bloxy Colas can stack with one another.
- Bloxy Cola's cans can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.overview: Casting Staff is an explosive weapon in Project Remix. It was released on June 29th, 2024.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Divisa can be activated instantly by Rime's lingering hitbox and Holy's crosses.
- If Rime is used as the second part in Frostburn or if an opponent is still inside Rime while hit by Combust, the damage and Cold from Rime will instantly be reapplied. This allows you to combo into another Frostburn up to 2 times (Combust > Rime > Combust > Combust).
- Planetoid is affected by gravity and can be casted upwards to guarantee full damage when falling down. This is very useful for area denial as it takes longer to fall, but it also makes it easier to be destroyed.
- Combust and Rime wont inflict their debuffs on an a player if they already have the debuff; however, their combos will still work as long as your Burning or Cold would still be in affect.
- Unlike Combust and Rime, Planetoid's hit status is a different debuff from Dazed, allowing the caster to hit 2 Orbitas in a row in quick succession.
- Debuffs from another Casting Staff user's spells allow other casters to hit combos, despite the debuff not being from the combo hitter.
- Rime and Astra are great for catching invisible players, both being AoE damage spells that can combo with another spell. This is great for catching the occasional Golden Knife user.
- Astra is one of the best main damage spells, being able to combo with 2 other spells for great damage, or with Disa for great AoE damage.
- Lunar Light does great single target damage, this is essential for getting the flag or killing the flag holder in the Fishin' for Flags gamemode.
- Casting Planetoid from high up allows the caster to engage fights with insane burst damage, sometimes even clearing out zones or groups of people at a time while also being out of range/vision for most players.
- Given enough preparation, Casting Staff can deal a lot of damage at once and fit virtually any playstyle/purpose. This weapon's charging gimmick makes it so predicting your opponent's next move and knowing exactly what to cast to stop them is very important to being able to win.
- if using lightning spear, try aiming flash at a group of enemies. Lightning spear's explosion occurs on every bounce and this can quickly shred clustered enemies if one or more of them has Burning.
[Countering]
- The Planetoid spell can and should be destroyed. It is susceptible to ranged attacks and is beneficial to the entire team if it doesn't explode.
- Getting out of it's line of sight is the second best way to avoid it in the case the team is does not destroy it.
- Casting Staff is very susceptible to surprise attacks, as they require time in order to cast spells which help their survival.
- Swiftcast however may have a spell saved such as Disa which sets them for an escape.
- Defensive abilities such as Barrier Shield or Personal Barrier can easily sponge the projectiles casted, preventing damage and forcing the Casting Staff user to need more setup.
- Abilities that cleanse or Impervious are very strong in getting rid of the debuffs inflicted, such as Purifying Prayer, Healing Potion or Fae Circle. They limit the potential of combos being activated.
- Despite being marked secondarily as a long ranged weapon, Casting staff can struggle at long ranges and especially if you have teammates in front of you to distract homing projectiles. Keeping your distance with other long ranged weapons can be effective.
weapons.trivia:
- There used to be a combo with Rime and Disa named Devia, but it was removed for being too damaging and too quick to activate.
- Disa used to be capable of teleporting through very small places, allowing you to access unreachable areas.
- The Starlight Scholar technique was accidentally leaked in the game, allowing players to use it before it came out, however it was unfinished only having 4 out of 10 spells made for the weapon.
- Information on this technique can be found on here.
- Starlight Scholar was renamed to School of Starlight, and is now intentionally available in private servers along with School of Alteration, although both are still unfinished with 4 and 3 spells respectively.
- Many of the Casting Staff's spells can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.
- This includes rime, even though it doesn't behave like a projectile thanks would be able to catch.

subSkills.name: Astel
subSkills.description: Astel is the first spell. When cast, summons 3 blue missile projectiles which homes onto enemies that are farther away. Each projectile deals 5 damage, totaling to 15.

subSkills.name: Combust
subSkills.description:
Combust is the second spell. When cast, summons a fast moving orange projectile which homes onto enemies that are farther away similar to Astel. It deals 15 damage and inflicts Burning for 6 seconds, dealing up to additional 60 damage for a total of 75 damage.

Combos with Astra to perform Astral Combust.

Combos with Rime to perform Frostburn.

subSkills.name: Rime
subSkills.description:
Rime is the third spell. When cast, summons 7 particles of snow in a V shaped formation which slowly move forward.

Deals an initial 35 damage and inflicts Cold for 3 second, totaling up to 47 damage. If the target is cleanse of Cold, Rime will deal damage and inflict the debuff again. The projectiles can pierce through enemies and constructs but breaks when colliding with a solid object.

Combos with Combust to perform Frostburn.

subSkills.name: Astra
subSkills.description:
Astra is the fourth spell. When cast, summons a fast moving arching projectile which explodes on collision. The explosion deals up to 45 damage and deals 75 damage on direct hits.

Combos with Combust to perform Astral Combust.

Combos with Planetoid to perform Orbita.

subSkills.name: Disa
subSkills.description:
Disa is the fifth spell. When cast, the user teleports in the opposite direction they're facing, leaving a purple decoy in their place.

When the decoy dies it explodes, dealing 90 damage in a small radius. The decoy has 35 health and is considered a humanoid construct. It dissipates after _ seconds.

After use, the spell slot turns red, signaling that it is weakened. In this weakened state, the user teleports a shorter distance and does not leave a decoy in their place.

Combo with any damage from the user performs Divisa.

subSkills.name: Salem
subSkills.description:
Salem is the sixth spell. When cast, it forms a green shield around the user, healing them for 50 health, granting 25 overhealth, and cleansing negative status effects.

After use, the spell slot turns red, signaling that is weakened. While weakened, the spell heals 25 health instead of 50 and no longer grants overhealth.

subSkills.name: Holy
subSkills.description:
Holy is the seventh spell. When cast, summons 8 holy crosses above the user. After a short delay, the crosses fly towards the closest enemy. Each cross deals 16.25 damage for a totaling to 130.

After use, the spell slot turns red, signaling that it is weakened. While weakened, Holy summons 4 crosses instead of 8.

subSkills.name: Moonbeam
subSkills.description:
Moonbeam is the eighth spell. When cast, fires a beam that lasts for 2 seconds and deals 80 damage per second. The beam has a max range of 150 studs and pierces through enemies, but not walls.

Combos with Combust to perform Polarity

Combos with Planetoid to perform Lunar Light

subSkills.name: Astella
subSkills.description: Astella is the ninth spell. When cast, summons a small portal in the user's position. The portal rapidly summons 15 projectiles which look and function similarly to Astel. Each projectile deals 10 damage, totaling to 150 damage.

subSkills.name: Planetoid
subSkills.description:
Planetoid is the tenth and final spell. When cast, summons a small moon construct which slowly grows in size and is affected by gravity.

The Planetoid has 175 health and is considered a humanoid construct. Additionally the user can stand on top of it.

The longer the Planetoid is alive, the bigger it grows, eventually reaching its maximum size. Upon collision, the Planetoid explodes, dealing damage dependent on its size. At max size, the explosion deals 125 damage and inflict Dazed in a 100-stud radius.

After use, the spell slot turns red, signaling that is weakened. While weakened, attempting to cast it causes an explosion damaging the user for 90 health and inflicting Dazed.

Combos with Astra to perform an Orbita

Combos with Moonbeam to perform Lunar Light

subSkills.name: Frostburn
subSkills.description:
Activates when casting Combust or Rime on a target inflicted with Cold or Burning respectively.

Deals 60 damage while removing Burning and Cold

subSkills.name: Astral Burst
subSkills.description:
Activates when casting Astra on a target with Burning

The explosion deals 85 damage onto targets with Burning and removes the status effect.

subSkills.name: Divisa
subSkills.description:
Activates when the user deals damage to their own decoy from Disa.

Detonates the decoy, dealing 90 damage in a small radius.

(Functionally, it is the same as Disa normally exploding, the only difference being activation)

subSkills.name: Polarity
subSkills.description:
Activates when casting Moonbeam on a target with Burning

Deals 35 damage to the target and enemies within 12 studs of them while pulling affected targets and the user towards each other, removing Burning.

subSkills.name: Orbita
subSkills.description:
Activates when casting Astra on targets which were recently hit by Planetoid.

Astra's explosion trips enemies for half a second and deals 75 damage.

subSkills.name: Lunar Light
subSkills.description:
Activates when casting Moonbeam on targets which were recently hit by Planetoid.

Deal 20-22 damage per tick with Moonbeam

subSkills.name: Flash
subSkills.description:
Activates when directly hitting a target with an uncharged Lightning Spear which were recently hit by Combust.

The spear does slightly less damage, removes Burning, inflicts Dazed for 0.8 seconds, and bounces towards a nearby enemy, prioritizing targets with Burning. Flash can trigger multiple times as long as the next target has Burning, ending when the spear strikes an unaffected target. Additional bounces will deal slightly more damage if the target has burning (activating another flash), and normal lightning spear damage if they do not.

weapons.name: Chakrams
effects: On chakram hit, replenish 30% of a charge.
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to dance, performing up to 3 hyper mobile dashes

Reduces distance of dash *abilities* by 50%
weapons.overview: Chakrams is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Your dashes are VERY important! They're how you initiate, escape, and keep your distance from your targets! Provided you land your hits, these dashes are very spammable and make for an excellent movement option.
- Areas with wide openings are your best friend, as it allows you to get the most out of your chakram's range and piercing.
- Having a natural dash option gives you the opportunity to get very offensive with your toolkit. Although most dash-related skills have their distance halved, it's not entirely useless to pick one up if you're craving the extra movement options.
- Try to position yourself somewhere that allows you to damage multiple enemies at once, and don't forget your dashes!
- Chakrams are very effective at dealing with large crowds. Tossing them into a crowd of enemies is a good way to rack up damage.
- Although they pass through walls, your blades will not damage enemies through them. They will still damage some objects like the explosive barrels on Mad Tech Factory and Trowel walls, however
[Countering]
- Heavier close-ranged weapons like the Ban Hammer, Equinox Blades, and Fists are very good at dealing with Chakram users. They have the bulk and mobility to stay close to a Chakram user and wail at them while they wait for their blades to return.
- Black Hand completely shuts down chakram users, reducing the effectiveness of their dashes when caught.
- Anything that's capable of pinning down a target works great against chakram users. Slipknot's Bola, Star Fragment, and Trowel are good solutions for limiting a chakram user's mobility.

weapons.overview:
Darkheart's appearance is visually similar to its SFOTH counterpart with the exception of the dark flame-like energy emanating from the blade. Its standard attack has the exact same animation and range as the Linked Sword but its secondary attack causes the character to perform a small windup spin before unleashing a myriad of dark slashes in a medium-sized radius around the character.

[Primary]
On use, swing to deal 40 damage with a cool down of 0.4 seconds in between each swing.

[Secondary]
On use, the user's camera will go into third person and performs a small windup spin. The user will then proceed to move forward while delivering multiple slashes to enemies in range for 22.5 damage 15 times during the attack to a total of 315 damage. This has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

[Passive]
Heal for 40% of damage dealt with Darkheart

After spawning near the left, make your way over so you can see the island straight ahead from you. If you look the bridge turning transparent. However if you look below you can tell where the bridge starts. You will be able to walk in a straight line from the two points.

Now you will be the island where the blue flame ring surrounds the Darkheart in the middle. After you pick up the Darkheart, you can take the portal to be teleported to the center portal.

weapons.name: E.T.Death
weapons.description: Use Secondary Fire for a powerful triple blast
weapons.overview: E.T.Death is a long range weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 15th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Maintain distance from enemies as much as possible, use any Ability(es) to escape or reposition yourself.
- Use Primary Attack to deal damage first, then finish enemies off with the Secondary Attack.
- Treat it like a DMR type of weapon. Use the Primary Fire for chip damage, and the Secondary Fire for heavier damage.
- E.T.Death has the least impactful falloff out of every weapon in Project Remix, use it to your advantage.
- Keep in note that, you can't zoom in or out using E.T.Death.
- It's recommended to use Portal Pair for its ability alter with E.T.Death, allowing for quicker repositioning, and easier escapes.
- With the short lifetime of portals while using E.T.Death, utilizing portals to quickly get up-close to enemies for easier shots, then backing out through the portals to maintain distance works very well as a way to finish off enemies, while staying safe.
[Countering]
- E.T.Death user generally weak in close range scenario, try to ambush quickly.
- Forcefields work extremely well against E.T.Death, and just cover in general. However, be mindful that Portal Pair can be placed through all forcefields.
- Most E.T.Death users run Portal Pair, and because of the short animation it has, dive can excel against a less experienced E.T.Death.
- You can use stun or slow Abilities like Black Hand, Star Fragment, or Tranquilizer Dart to pacify their Portal Pair tricks.

[Recommended Loadouts]
Community submitted loadouts!
weapons.trivia: - E.T.Death is the first weapon to receive an ability alter, exclusive skin and is notably the first weapon not based off a Roblox gear. It is instead a reference to Homemade_Meal's Tunneler.

weapons.overview: Equinox Blades is a melee weapon in Project Remix. It was released on July 25th, 2024.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Equinox Blades' third-person POV allows the user to peek corners, scout enemies, and prepare attacks.
- Entering Equinox Stance slows the user down by 50%, using it with have an attack in mind reduces the downtime.
- Using the Tertiary exits Equinox Stance.
- Nightingale can be used to initiates fights, especially when applying Antiheal to enemy healers.
- Lightspeed excels in duels, healing 100% of the damage dealt and summoning holy crosses which follow up on attacks.
- Ambushing an enemy can help get the most out of the attack.
- Black Hand can be used to prevent enemies from getting away during attacks.
[Countering]
- Equinox Blades struggles against vertical abilities and positioning, climbing up walls or using abilities can help avoid dangerous attacks.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Community submitted Loadouts!
weapons.trivia:
- Stated by Homemade_meal, "Equinox blades were inspired by rennala’s twin blades from the elden ring dlc. [sic]"
- Equinox Blade's holy crosses can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: General's .45
weapons.description:
Hold Down the Secondary Fire to instantly reload all 6 rounds and enter Quickdraw

Completely eliminates firing cooldown during Quickdraw
weapons.overview: General's .45 is a long range weapon in Project Remix. It was released on February 13th, 2025.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
It is best to utilize Quickdraw to finish off the enemy after weakening them with primary shots.
Use the bomb combo to finish off any opponent trying to run away or to deal damage to a greater group of enemies.
Go for headshots

If you are using the try your luck variant, using Quickdraw inside a cramped space is almost certain death for any opponent that is also in said cramped space with you.

With the time bomb alteration, you can effectively attack around corners or barriers by throwing the time bomb past the wall and shooting it.
[Countering]
With General's .45 limited ammo capacity and lengthy reload, it is very vulnerable to being baited into taking wasteful shots and then rushed down. There still needs to be caution, as the secondary ability can quickly shred HP.
weapons.trivia:
- There is a bug with the time bomb alteration, where you can "explode" the opponent's thrown time bomb, though this is only visual and causes the time bomb to only go invisible on your screen.
- General's .45 bullets can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.description:
Secondary Fire will rapidly launch the rest of your grenades onto a single area, destroying enemy defenses while inflicting immense damage

Secondary Fire will inflict DEFENSE SHRED to enemies with damage resistance, reducing enemy damage resistance by 65% for 3 seconds

Primary Fire grenades will explode on direct hit or shortly after a bounce
weapons.overview: Grenade Launcher is an explosive weapon in Project Remix. It was released on November 13th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Grenade Launcher plays best at mid-range. Not too far, not too close.
- Grenade Launcher's explosions have a generous hitbox, but it's always best to go for direct hits.
- Prediction of enemy movement is key.
- Aim for multiple enemies.
- The Sticky Grenades technique is good for making traps or providing sudden burst damage.
- You are NOT immune or resistant to your own explosions' knockback or damage; which can work with or against your favor; this is apparent with Sticky Grenades where setting up one or more allows you to sticky jump, providing insane mobility.
- Self-healing Abilities are recommended as they provide recovery from self-damage.
- Health Perks are recommended as they increase survivability of self-damage.

[Countering]

- Grenade Launcher cannot fight anyone too far or too close to them. Keep your distance or close the gap.
- Grenades must travel to you before they deal damage. Evasion via unpredictable movement is key.
- If you're covered in Sticky Bombs: seek burst-healing or kill the Sticky Bombs' owner.
- Be wary of bouncing shots! A clever Volatile Grenades user can bounce their grenades around corners and ledges to hit targets while remaining unseen.
- Powerful counters such as Slingshot's "Thanks!" swinging invalidates incoming mid-air Grenade Launcher grenades.
weapons.trivia:
- The model of this weapon is based on Newtrat's Tuskinator which closely resembles the "Stickybomb Launcher" from Team Fortress 2.
- Grenade Launcher's grenades can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.
- Sticky Bombs can stick to enemies in the process of reviving via Eternal Flame.

passives: Refill lunge charges upon getting a kill
effects: On lunge, apply 1.5 seconds of bleed
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to slice forward up to 3 times

Inflicts stacking Bleed damage to enemies for 1.5 seconds
weapons.overview: Katana is a melee weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Katana is a "glass cannon" weapon archetype. It can deal big chunks of damage in favor of low health pool, so be always aware of it and manage your resources carefully.
- Katana gives the user a big passive movement speed bonus, don't be afraid to start unexpected fights with your opponent and chase them.
- User can also benefit from picking perks that increase their movement speed, such as Body: Small or Drifter.
- Using Secondary Fire will slow down the user in the air, which allows fighting opponents in the air easier.
- User benefits a lot from engaging in the fights, due to enemy's bleed damage healing and regaining the Secondary Fire charges on secured kills, even if it is an assisted kill.

[Countering]
- Katana becomes almost powerless without its Secondary Fire charges, be sure to drain opponent's resources before engaging or keep the distance with them by using abilities such as Forward Barrier.
- One of the ways to fight Katana is to reduce their movement. Try abilities such as Star Fragment or Megawatt Fencing to make sure they can't use much movement.
- Due to Katana's low health pool you can easily get the opponent low, which may cause them to retreat.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Community submitted Loadouts!
weapons.trivia: - The slow down effect after lunging is affected by Susceptible/Impervious.

weapons.overview:
The technique granted a Secondary Fire which allowed the user to lunge forward, inflicting bleed on enemies they dash through. This ability could store up to three charges. Kills granted +50 overhealth instantly. In exchange, bleed no longer healed the user.

To The Finish traded off immediate sustain for overhealth on kill. Player became very difficult to kill if they were allowed to start their kill chain.

[Primary]
When held, swings the Katana forward dealing 35 damage on a cooldown of 0.4 seconds.

Has a melee range of 8.5 studs.

[Secondary]
Lunges in the direction the user is facing, traveling at 240 SPS for 0.1 seconds while slowing down movement by 50% for 0.6 seconds.

On hit, deals an initial 40 damage and inflicts Bleed, a stackable debuff dealing 17.5 DPS, for 1.5 seconds.

After the lunge ends, it cannot be used for 0.5 seconds.

Holds up to 3 charges, replenishing 1 after 4 seconds. Upon killing a player or humanoid construct, all 3 charges are replenished.

[Passives]
Grants +50 overhealth on kill (max of +50)

effects: Holding M3 pushes the player away from target
weapons.description: No weapon modifications
weapons.overview: Laser Finger Pointers is a support weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Always be adaptive, try to use different attack variant (damage/heal/knockback) to recharge other attack variant.
- You will mainly use either the damage and heal variant, but you can also use knockback variant when the enemy like to get closer with you.
- Combine with Rebound perk, allowing you to escape from the enemy with the knockback bonus.
- The range is pretty short, you need to stay close to medium with your teammates or enemies.
- Be aware around your surrounding, as you still counted as Support.
- Laser Finger Pointers: Standard Weaponry variant is a hitscan, allowing you to deal damage/heal/knockback at your crosshair.
- Exception of Laser Finger Pointers: Advanced Targeting variant, as it become a fast projectile weapon.
- You can only use 1 attack variant at a time, decide which attack variant is the best to use in certain scenario.
[Countering]
- Quickly ambushing Laser Finger Pointers user is a good way to distract the healing variant, giving a chance for your teammates to finish other enemies.
- Using ranged weapon or quick-dash melee weapon (Linked Sword, Katana, Laser Scythe, etc) is heavily recommended to counter Laser Pointer Finger user who often to use knockback attack variant.
- Abilities like Black Hand, Tranquilizer Dart, and Star Fragment is also a good way to limit Laser Pointer Finger user movement.
- Applying Antiheal reduce Laser Pointer Finger user healing effectiveness.

Community submitted Loadouts!

weapons.name: Laser Scythe
effects: Primary Fire heals 25 health with each hit. Secondary Fire heals 75 health on successful hit, otherwise deals 15% of the user's max health.
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to fire an energy projectile, teleporting to wherever it lands

Hitting an opponent with the projectile will heal for 75 health but will drain 15% of your health if missed.
weapons.overview: Laser Scythe is a melee weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 15th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Laser Warp and Laser Leech's Secondary Fire can be used to exit fights, especially in overwhelming scenarios or unfavorable match ups.
- However, it should be used in caution as the Secondary Fire will take a percentage of health.
- The healing granted from Laser Scythe allows it to outlast most opponents despite its lower health pool, especially when high damage abilities have already been exhausted.
- After hitting an enemy with Secondary Fire, immediately swing with Primary Fire and then Quick Kick for a huge burst of damage.
- Utilize the teleport to attack enemy healers and ranged users directly, picking them off for your team.

[Countering]
- Avoid getting hit by Laser Scythe's Secondary Fire by strafing or just moving unpredictably in general. The more they miss - the more self damage they take.
- Defensive abilities such as Personal Barrier, Trowel, or Forward Barrier can effectively block attacks while preventing Laser Scythe's healing.
- Antiheal is an effective counter to Laser Scythe's healing, reducing their constant sustain.
weapons.trivia:
- Hitting humanoid constructs such as the Summoner's Codex Birds or NPCs will count as landing Secondary Fire, granting healing.
- Secondary Fires can be canceled by using abilities that unequip the user's weapon. This can prevent self damage, however the cooldown will be active.
- Movement speed buffs / debuffs do not affect Laser Warp or Laser Leech's Secondary Fire's teleport.
- Laser Scythe and Casting Staff are the only weapons with a built-in teleport.
- Laser Scythe's energy projectiles can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.overview: Legacy Skateboard was a melee weapon in Project Remix. It was released on November 26th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Targeting isolated supports or low health players are good options to secure kills while benefiting themselves or the team.
- While using Swerve, the enhanced Quick Kick contributes heavily to overall damage output of the weapon. It should be used as much as possible.
- Using it as a finishing option allows the user to use the increased self knockback to exit fights.
- Using Dash I, Dash II, or Rejuvenating Dash while using the Secondary Fire retains the velocity boost granted from the dash, allowing to user to gain high speeds very quickly.
- Dash II allows for more flexibility with its two charges and low cooldown.
- Hop can be used to instantly redirect the velocity's direction while retaining the speed.
- Skateboard's Secondary is completely unaffected by movement speed bonuses and penalities. (Only exception is for Dazed)
- Both Body: Large's movement speed cap and Chezburger's Heavy have no effects on the speed, meaning it can be viable to run a bulkier build for self-sustain.
- Learning the general layout of maps can help with smooth navigation.
- Understanding where the health packs are is crucial as it allow users to quickly recover missing health and re-enter fights.
[Countering]
- Utility abilities such as Star Fragment or Black Hand can inhibit Skateboard's movement.
- Dazed slows them down significantly and limits or disables other movement abilities the user may have.
- Black Hand disables the use of the Secondary Fire completely.
- Defensive abilities such as Trowel, Personal Barrier, or Forward Barrier can quickly stuff the Skateboard's path, making the user harder to reach.
- Swerve could Quick Kick it and use the self knockback to travese elsewhere.
- Take advantage of Skateboard's short melee range by playing vertically and keeping distance.
- Flight, Gravity Disruptor, or Icarus are solid abilities to reposition with.
- Chasing a retreating Skateboard should only be done if the user is sure they can finish them off.
- Their plan may be to lure them into an environment which favors the Skateboard user.
- Lightning Spear is an excellent counter as it is able to lock on to Skateboard's speed and inflicting Dazed on hit.
weapons.trivia:
- Skateboard's Primary Fire used to be manual, requiring the user to tap rather then hold in order to deal damage.
- Skateboard can recover from non-humanoid constructs.

weapons.overview: Legacy Summoner's Codex is a support weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Keep placing you phoenixes as close to the enemy as possible. Bring your phoenix to you when your phoenix is low.
- Use blue when your team is jumping someone, use green to heal your team and use red to kill people.
- Your healing and damage are separate so you can't heal yourself which means taking a healing ability will greatly increase survivability.
- Constantly summon phoenixes to maximize damage and utility, as well as giving mana back which can be used to heal your phoenix or teammates.
- Your phoenix can be helpful in picking off low enemies and providing health.
- Having an infliction ability such as Anti-heal potion, Poison Mist and Star Fragment can help with increasing the damage from Codex, as well as inflicting crippling debuffs on enemies.

[Countering]
- If it is down, stay away from the green phoenix as much as possible.
- They can't defend themselves very well so as soon as they get blue or green phoenix down focus them before they cause any more problems.
- Anti-heal potion can cripple codex severely as codex relies on healing to stay afloat.
- Using Purifying Prayer or Fae Circle forces codex to reapply debuffs, shutting down their abilities.
- While infeasible, extreme healing and shield application makes codex unable to kill players due to their innate low damage per second.
weapons.trivia:
- Summoner's Codex is the first weapon to get Legendary skins being Fairy Lantern and Fae Lantern.
- The Summoner's Flame effect used to be a different effect called Detonation
- Detonation would cause the affected player to explode for 60% of the damage dealt to them during the duration after it ended.

weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to summon a thundercloud that periodically strikes lightning down onto enemies

Hitting multiple enemies with your thundercloud will chain lightning between enemies for bonus damage
weapons.overview: Lightning Wand is an explosive weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 28th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Try to predict your enemies movement, as the projectile speed from Primary Attack isn't that fast.
- The AoE from the Primary Attack is decent enough to chip damage the enemies.
- Try to hit the enemies as often as you can to get Mana and health. Don't spam Primary Attack too much if you didn't hit any enemies with it.

- Closed place and small place is a good way to limits your enemies movement option and higher chance to hit your shots much often!
- Self damage exist in Lightning Wand, try to not get hit by your own electricity or uses it to gain height at a cost of few health.
- The lightning cloud deals good damage, especially when there is a lot of enemies gathered into 1 area. Make sure to spawn the lightning cloud near those enemies to get bonus damage.
- You could hold click the Secondary Button to see the location of the lightning cloud spawn in circular shape on the grounds. It could reach to medium range, soo you don't have to worry to spawn it close to the enemies.
- It also have low cooldown, soo you could spawn it pretty often.
- The more enemies around the lightning cloud, more damage it deals. Make sure to spawn it when the enemies team gather into one area. Especially in gamemodes like King Of The Hill, Subspace Takeover, and Subspace Transport.
[Countering]
- They are pretty fragile due to their Max Health penalty, use this to your advantage to quickly finish the Lightning Wand user.
- Always keep moving and be unpredictable to make Lightning Wand user harder to aim at you.
- Combine with jumping, strafing, and Abilities!
- Staying in high grounds or mid-air is also recommended.
- They are less of a threat in mid to long range. Try to deal with them at distances if you can't get a closer attacks to them.
weapons.trivia: - Lightning Wand's lightning bolts can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Linked Sword
effects: Deal 200% lunge damage to enemies under 50% max health.
weapons.description: Use Secondary Fire to lunge forward, dealing 200% lunge damage to enemies under 50% health
weapons.overview: Linked Sword is a melee weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 20th, 2023.
weapons.tips:
[Official Tips]
These are official tips displayed on death.
- Linked Sword can knock you out, but only if you're under half health! Keep yourself healthy! (When killed by Riposte's Secondary Fire)
- That Linked Sword is using Paladin's Oath! When you're marked for a Divine Smite, keep your health over 30% to prevent them from executing you! (When killed by Paladin's Oath Secondary Fire)
- You were marked by a Linked Sword! When you're under the effects of Divine Smite, you will take more damage from all sources, so it may be better to hide! (When killed by Paladin's Oath Secondary Fire)
[Playing]
- Using the Drifter Perk combined with Movement Abilities can enhance general movement.
- Paladin's Oath's lunge triggers Drifter, however Riposte's does not.
- Alternatively, High Climb Perk may be helpful in chasing enemies vertically or performing Wall Hops.
- With Riposte or Paladin's Oath, prioritize squishy players such as ranged or support users. Their low health pools make for easier targets and killing them benefits the entire team.
- Enemies under 50% health should also be prioritized as they can be executed easily.
- Riposte's Secondary Fire should also be used to escape situations if needed.
- While using Paladin's Oath, focus on damaging marked targets to make sure the execution is successful.

[Countering]
- Mainly being a single target melee, its always advisable to stay in group as they can be overwhelmed easily.
- Royal Guard is very susceptible to ranged attacks. Although the parry can reduce the damage dealt, having distance has no repercussions.
- When getting marked by the Paladin's Oath technique at low health, quickly request for healing or find a health pack to prevent the execution effect.
- Both Riposte and Royal Guard have a difficult time targeting enemies in the air.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Default Loadout

Community submitted loadouts!
weapons.trivia:
- Linked Sword was the first weapon to be shown alongside the initial development of Project Remix.
- It can be viewed here on twitter.
- Riposte and both Laser Scythe's Laser Warp and Laser Leech techniques share the same Secondary Fire animation.
- Linked Sword used to have an alteration with Purifying Prayer called Golden Vow, which was a reference to a similar spell in Elden Ring called Golden Vow
- Paladin's Oath's holy swords can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

- Dying whilst charging Paladin's Oath Primary Fire causes the holy swords to remain active, disappearing after a few seconds.

weapons.name: Paintball Gun
effects: On hit, highlight the enemy for 5 seconds.
weapons.description:
Infinite ammo at the cost of a slow fire rate

Paintballs will mark and reveal enemies through walls to you and your team for 5 seconds

-25 max health
weapons.overview: Paintball Gun is a long ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Hitting enemies highlights them for 5s for your team and yourself. This allows you to track them down if they try to escape or just generally predict their movement.
- Highlight stays even if the opponent is under the effect of Invisible.
- Keep the distance from the battlefield but not too far, as despite being a marksman rifle, the Paintball Gun is subject to fall-off. Reposition when necessary.
- You can use a ranged remix to increase your survivability while still providing value. The best example is Aerial Support or Remote Airstrike.
- Abilities that keep players away such as Time Bomb and Throwing Javelin are highly recommended to keep flankers away from you and giving you a better shot.

[Countering]
- Flank Paintball Gun users and pressure them, as they tend to have poor matchups up-close, but they still have high burst damage and most tend to use abilities to fall back and/or keep you away.
- If you're hit by a Paintball Gun, remember you are highlighted on their screen. This is especially dangerous if you rely on invisibility to flank enemies.
weapons.trivia:
- Canister's balloons are based off the user's crosshair color.
- Paintball Gun's paintballs can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Pistol
effects: +200% thrown pistol damage to targets under 50% health.
weapons.description: Take your time to steady your shots, firing slower but keeping yourself from any recoil
weapons.overview: Pistol is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- As a relatively mobile fast-firing weapon, take advantage of your speed and dash abilities to be harder to hit. The Body: Small perk is incredibly useful for this.
- Remember to finish off players under 50% HP! Your damage is lowered against anything under half HP, so finish them off with a quick throw. This is especially important against much tankier enemies using weapons such as Fists. Otherwise, more fragile enemies such as Summoner's Codex users can be killed by simply firing them to death. Remember that the thrown Pistol is a slower projectile with an arc compared to bullets, so adjust your aim accordingly.
- Thrown Pistols also deal bonus damage against forcefields under half health (such as the Subspace Takeover forcefield, the Flag in Fishing for Flags, etc.) Take advantage of this to tear through such forcefields.
- With Chronorelease, you have the potential to deal huge damage against single or multiple targets and finish them off with your thrown pistol in a single volley. Your frozen bullets do not deal damage towards players under 40% HP, but your thrown pistol will. Dual Arm bullets will still damage players under 40% HP.
[Countering]
- As speedy and deadly Pistol users are, particularly those with Steady Fire and Full Auto, they are fairly fragile and their DPS lowers if you are under half HP, but they won't hesitate to throw their Pistol to finish you off. As mentioned earlier the Pistol is a projectile the user has to adjust their aim to finish you off, try to dodge the throw.
- Using abilities to keep them in place such as Star Fragment and Slipknot's Bola keeps them from running around and peppering you to death.
- Against Chronorelease users, pressuring them is an easy way to kill them, but beware if they already have a volley setup, as one can easily finish you off with one.
weapons.trivia:

weapons.overview:
The Rocket Launcher is a simple explosive weapon that fires out rockets dealing moderate damage with its splash and also capable of mobility by boosting the user with it's primary fire.

[Primary]
On use, fires a rocket that moves at 120 studs per second. Upon impact explodes, dealing up to 75 damage in a ~15 stud radius and dealing 100 damage on direct hits. Takes ~2.1 seconds to reload between each shots.

Those not directly hit by the explosion take some knockback including the user.

[Secondary]
On use, zooms in.

- Blade Damage Dealt

- Damage Blocked

weapons.description:
Hold down Secondary to reduce forward incoming damage by 70% (at the cost of mobility)

While using Warden Stance, tap Primary Fire instead of holding to use Warden's Axe at the cost of charges

Landing Warden's Axe will recover ammo and grant overhealth
weapons.overview: Rotary Chaingun is a ranged weapon in Project Remix. It was released on September 12th, 2025 as the reworked version of the Minigun.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Whenever you get the chance, remember to reload! Rotary Chaingun chews through ammo VERY quickly!
- Warden Stance is best used to hold down an area, or to bunker down against multiple enemies!
- While you can’t move in Warden Stance, you can still use movement abilities.
- Warden’s Axe is an excellent tool against those in melee range, but use it sparingly! Sometimes it’s better to keep shooting your targets for more consistent damage.
- HOLDING M1 After using Warden’s Axe will cause you to start firing as soon as possible.
- You can use Dash I and Dash II during Warden’s Axe to extend the lunge.
- Mutual Benefit is one of the best perks to use, as it benefits from all of Rotary Chaingun’s overhealth gaining abilities.
- Body: Large and Bonus Health are close seconds, as they increase your overall survivability.
- Your overhealth on kill also procs from Codex Phoenixes, Kin Zombies, Burst Rifle Drones, Casting Staff Planetoids/Disas, Censer Clones and Hallucinations.

[Countering]
- Catch them while they’re reloading! In those few seconds that a Rotary Chaingun can’t fight back, you can easily burst them down with most weapons.
- You can easily catch a Rotary Chaingun during Warden’s Axe, too. It’s a big attack with a long, abusable animation that makes the Rotary a free target if it misses.
- When they’re in Warden Stance, aim for their back where they lack damage resistance!
- You can also force them to exit Warden Stance with AoE abilities.
- Weapons like Tommy Gun, Slingshot, and Katana make quick and easy work of Rotary Chaingun, regardless if they’re in Warden Stance or not.
- Long-ranged weapons like E.T. Death and Paintball Gun also perform well, but also work to force Chaingunners into moving positions.
- Censer performs amazingly against Chaingun due to their slow movement speed and tendency to bunker down, making them easy ritual targets.
weapons.trivia:
- Overhealth gain is unaffected by healing multipliers, including Heal Boost and Antiheal
- The Warden Axe attack grants ammo and overhealth on non-humanoid constructs, not just players
- Rotary Chaingun's bullets can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Shotgun
effects: Dazed (Stock Charge)
weapons.description:
Hold down Secondary Fire to charge forward before releasing to bash enemies

A powered charge will daze opponents for 1 second
weapons.overview: Shotgun is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
- Frontline and Coach Gun's M2 allows you to trimp off certain slopes (IE: The rocks on Kin and Titanic's terrain on the second map).
- The shotgun can also be reloaded while charging, which is especially important for Coach Gun with its reduced ammo count and faster firerate.

- Frontline/Coach Gun charge damage is based on the time m2 is held, from 35 up to 50, and can activate Drifter.

[Playing]
- Use it at close range and aim towards the enemy's head to blow out a massive chunk of their health. Take advantage of your mobility and flank routes to take enemies by surprise.

- Frontline's charge can be used to close the distance with enemies and/or to follow up with a quick shot to their face. There is a windup to this charge, meaning this won't perform well if you're already engaged up-close. It can also be used as a getaway tool. The daze is meant to keep enemies from easily running away from you, so use the window of opportunity to finish them off and properly engage them.

- Stock Bash trades the mobility and damage potential of Frontline's charge for an on-demand daze and melee strike. It pairs well with movement abilities, like Sprint. This instant damage and daze makes it insanely strong for dealing huge damage up-close, and can be comboed with Primary Fire, then Secondary and Quick Kick for potentially high damage, up to 179 with a perfect headshot.

- Compression pairs well with abilities that keep enemies away, like Javelin or Time Bomb. Unlike the other variants, you lack a melee attack and charge. Take advantage of the lower spread while holding down ADS to shoot enemies from afar and close the distance slowly.

- Coach Gun gives you incredible mobility potential at the cost of survivability and sustainability in combat. Take advantage of the self-knockback, charge, movement abilities and the Drifter perk to close distances between enemies and even dive-bomb them with the charge. The self-knockback however, makes it hard to deal consistent damage as you're flinging yourself away from enemies; this is where the charge also comes in to close the distance again.

[Countering]
- Keep your distance from Shotgun users, as they are notably mobile and powerful up-close. Compression users are even deadlier since they also have a lower spread while aiming, but they are less likely to be hyper-mobile.
- Despite being a ranged weapon, this weapon will absolutely demolish melee players due to its high burst damage at close to point-blank range, especially against Stock Bash users. Try to take Shotgun users by surprise if you are wielding a melee weapon and use dash abilities to dodge much easier.
weapons.trivia:
- Originally Shotgun was a snowballing based weapon, gaining permanent increased movement speed with each kill.
- Because of the gameplay interaction with Icarus, the Compression technique can display a cooldown despite not having one.
- Shotgun's pellets can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.overview:
This technique traded ammo count and firing speed for a +35% damage bonus, allowing it deal heavy damage in the right conditions. It was taken out of the game due to many complaints about its incredibly high damage at close range.

[Primary]
When held, fires 19 hitscan pellets in a fixed hexagon shaped spread. Each pellet has a bullet size of 1.2 studs, deals 5.4 damage on bodyshot or 8.1 damage on headshot totaling to 102.6 and 153.9 damage respectively. In between each shot there is a cooldown of 1.05 seconds.

Additionally experiences damage falloff beginning at 15 studs of distance, decreasing the damage by ?% per stud down to a minimum of ?% damage at 90 studs of distance.

Holds up to 3 shells before needing to reload which takes ? seconds to do.

[Secondary]
When held, the user begins charging forward, accelerating to around 70 S/PS.

After ~1.5 seconds or on release, it halts the user's horizontal velocity and bashes enemies in front of them, dealing damage dependent on how long the Secondary was held for. At minimum it deals 35 damage, at maximum it deals 50 damage and applies Dazed for 1 second.

After bashing, the cooldown begins, lasting for 4 seconds.

weapons.name: Slingshot
effects: Upon activating fast firing, quickly shoot bullets at the cost of accuracy
weapons.description: Use Secondary Fire to begin firing unstable rapid shots for up to 2 seconds
weapons.overview: Slingshot is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
- Slingshot is best treated as a mid-range projectile weapon, with its decent firerate and headshot damage but middling projectile speed.
- The perk Body: Small is useful in making you a fast and slippery target.
[Playing]
- Fast Firing is a consistent, high-firerate DPS technique that becomes especially dangerous in close range.
- Tri-Shot grants a secondary fire that turns it into a strong burst-damage option, where the secondary fire becomes its primary option and the primary fire can be used as a finisher for players low on health.
- "Thanks!" is slightly more niche, as it depends on the enemy team using projectiles. When applicable it can be a formidable counter to many weapons and abilities, not only denying your opponents their powers but also turning them against themselves.
- Remember that you can also catch your allies' projectiles. While you should watch to make sure you aren't denying your allies their abilities, this also means you can have a friend provide a consistent supply of strong options.
- The capturing effect has a short delay on startup, so don't rely on reaction times to catch faster projectiles.
- "Thanks!" relies on Mana, so watch your resources closely when pairing with mana-heavy abilities like Regenerate or Life Tether.
[Countering]
- Rushing a Slingshot player down with melee weapons can overwhelm them quickly, as melee weapons typically have similar or greater DPS that is easier to hit in melee range.
- Conversely, using long-ranged weapons that can hit more consistently due to Slingshot's middling projectile speed can beat it out in a long-distance firefight.
- If you are fighting a "Thanks!" user and are wielding a ranged weapon that isn't E.T.Death or Chronorelease Pistol, wait for them to drop their net to fire. Even if they start swinging again, there is a short delay before they can catch projectiles where they are vulnerable. Kicking in close range is also an option.
- If you are a melee user, however, simply pressuring them is enough unless they have projectiles in store.
weapons.trivia: - Slingshot's pellets can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Slipknot
weapons.description:
Use Secondary Fire to throw out a bola to hold enemies still for shots

Snares a single enemy player for up to 1.5 seconds

Additionally drags airborne players to the ground
weapons.overview: Slipknot is a long ranged weapon in Project Remix. It was released on February 13th, 2025.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Despite being made for long range purposes, it is still viable to use in medium and close range.
- Its not recommended to attack enemies from long range, as Slipknot uses a projectile arrow.
- Its better to target enemy in medium range to close range to get the most hit.
- Its generally recommended to held it at max charge to deal maximum damage and fast travel time.
- Since Slipknot is a fast projectile weapon, you need to slightly predict the enemy movement.
- Slipknot: Slighnot variant will make the enemy "stuck" for a while, giving you much easier time to hit your shots.
- Keeping distances or moving backward in chases is recommended to get the reversed damage falloff effect, dealing more damage and killing the enemy much faster.
- Not applied to Slipknot: Tempo variant, as the variant remove the reversed damage falloff effect.
[Countering]
- Slipknot have a pretty long kill time due to holding mechanic, try to use Weapons that deal burst or quick damage to take them down.
- Keep trying to get a fair or close distance against Slipknot user, reducing reverse damage falloff effect.
- When got "stuck" against Slipknot: Slighnot's bola variant, you can still move around the bola area and allowed to jump slightly.
- You unable to destroy the trap, keep focusing on moving side to side and attack if you can.
- You can use Lightning Spear, Star Fragment or any Dazed effect to counter almost any Slipknot variant, especially Slipknot: Dryfire variant user to reduce their escape options.

Secondary Fire will use mana to send life blossoms that will burst to heal major amounts of health

Healing allies will recover mana

Mana recovery from healing is 50% of healing dealt. Bloom costs 40 mana, heals allies for 60 (+15 over 2s), and deals 30 (+15 bleed over 2s) damage to enemies.
weapons.overview: Staff of Life is a support weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 29, 2023.
weapons.tips:
- Always try to get behind teammates or nearby wall, while keeping the heal beam locked to one of your teammates.
- Combining strafing and jumping will be helpful to keep yourself sustainable during the fights.
- Don't afraid to use the secondary attack if necessary.
- Always keep your heal beams on the player, don't let it off unless to escape or wanted to use certain Abilities or Remix.
- Due to low offensive options, try to play passively and defensively.
- Don't be alone, stick with your teammates and run to them if your teams spawned pretty far from you.
- Try to use Abilities that will help you escape if you felt you will either get teamed on or the player you heal is near KO.
- Try to only lock to 1 player when initiating a fights.
Recommended Perks:
- Bonus Health = Sustainability and reliable.
- Medica / Abundance = Fully support oriented playstyle.
- Body:Small = Lesser of being targetted.
- Swiftcast = Flexibility to use your Abilities often.
- Impervious = Good option if enemy teams has a lot of debuff/negative effects.
Recommended Abilities:
- Backflight / Dash I / Dash II / Rejunevating Dash = Quick but short getaway jailcard.
- Flight / Jetpack = Good ways to make yourself hard to target while healing your teammates and to escape.
- Chezburger / Healing Potion / Regenerate = Own sustainability.
- Purifying Prayer / Healing Screen / Life Tether = Support oriented playstyle.
- Poison Knives / Sidearm = Ranged offensive options.
- Javelin Throw / Time Bomb / Forward Barrier = To make distances between enemies and yourself.
- Trowel / Personal Barrier = If the maps is too open and no cover available.
Recommended Remixes:
- Bubble Barrier = Wall to keep healing safely.
- Fae Circle = Consistent healing and support.
- Divine Veil / Artemis' Bow = Offensive and support at the same time.
[Playing]
As a Staff Of Life user, you need to play much carefully and focused on healing your teams. Always behind your teams, lock the heal onto them, and do not be the frontline, as you don't have any good offensive options.

When locking the heal into one of your team, be aware of the situations. If your team is being too close to the enemy territory, play safely and skedaddle (run) from the fights if its getting too intense. Healers like you are very important to stay alive, as it will benefits the team for the long run. Better to not sacrificing yourself if the end was the team loses a lot of lives.

Always keep moving, don't stop. Expect many enemies will target onto you. Strafe, jump, behind walls, behind teammates, high grounds, aware of your positions in the fight.

And, always keep the heal lock to one of your teammates, even before the fights begin.
[Countering]
Like any unfortunate healers in any experiences or games, targetting them first will be a wise choice. But it won't be easy, as they will lock their heal lock to one of the enemy team, making it a 2v1 fight. Try to get into positions where both of them didn't recognize your ambush/flank and attack the Staff Of Life user first, then either run or fight the remaining enemy. You can also ask for help for your teammates to distract them or to exterminate them both.

Sees an alone, unhelpful Staff Of Life user? Exterminate immediately. Don't let healers come back to their team.

Abilities like Anti-Heal Potion is a good way to negate most healing factor from enemy Staff Of Life user (and to make Staff Of Life user sobbing). It will grant your teammates easier way to finish the enemy team off.

weapons.name: Staff of Life: Better Together

meta.image: Staff of Life Better Together Icon.png

passives: +40% Movement Speed while more or 40 studs away from an ally.
Heals allies for 5 health per second when within 40 studs an ally.
weapons.description:
+40% Movement Speed while more or 40 studs away from an ally.

Secondary Fire to increase healing output by 2.5x and grant +15% damage reduction to you and your target at the cost of mana

Additionally grants slight health regen to self and allies

-30% targeting range.
weapons.overview:
The technique was similar to Surge with it's primary and secondary fire have the same function. However, it provided a passive which increased your movement speed when away from allies and provided small healing overtime to allies within radius, at the cost of it's primary fire having 30% reduced range.

[Primary]
When held, locks a beam onto the closest ally to the cursor within a 49 stud radius. The beam heals the connected target for 40 HP per second.

Breaking line of sight or being further then 59 studs from the target disconnects the beam after a short delay.

[Secondary]
When held while during the Primary Fire, boosts the beam's healing output by 250%, increasing it to 100 HP per second while granting both the user and the connected target 25% damage reduction. Consumes Mana.

[Passives]
- While being 40 studs away from any ally, increases your speed by 40%.
- While being 40 studs in range from any ally, heals every ally in a 40 stud radius by 5 health per second.
- Self-heals for 40% of healing dealt
weapons.trivia: - The speed and healing passives would persist even when switching to a different weapon.

weapons.name: Stellar Tune
passives: Gain 10% of damage dealt from allies in a 40 stud radius as Mana.
effects: Primary Fire grants the user 2.5 Action Points upon hitting an enemy.
Secondary Fire grants increased movement speed based on how many allies are in range.
weapons.description:
Primary Fire will fire combusting magical stars at the cost of Mana while Secondary Fire will boost ally damage

Dealing damage will heal allies in your aura for 35% of damage dealt while restoring your Action Points

Harsh Tone boosts nearby allies' damage by +7.5% (aura no longer heals allies or grants damage resistance). Stellar Tune no longer grants damage reduction to self.
weapons.overview: Stellar Tune is a support weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]
- Secondary fire is great for retreating, whether you are low on health or have depleted primary ammo. It is also its primary means of supporting the team by healing and speeding your team up, allowing for some strong pushes.

- Incredible speeds can be achieved with secondary fire combined with it's alter ability, Starspeed. Just be careful of dazing yourself with the Star Fragment.
[Countering]
- As Stellar Tune users tend to be incredibly mobile with their secondary fire and already high passive, slowing them down by any means is a great way to prevent them from pushing further.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Default Loadout
weapons.trivia:
- This weapon is a reference to the weapon of the same name.
- Stellar Tune is the only weapon in the game that uses both Mana and Action Points.

- Stellar Tune's attacks can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.name: Summoner's Codex
weapons.description:
A summoner's best friend. Summon 3 different types of phoenix (250 max health, tied to user's mana) to attack and apply debuffs to nearby enemies. Press 1, 2, 3, or scroll to swap phoenix.

Summoning no longer restores mana, and phoenixes despawn if out of line of sight for longer than 6 seconds.

Primary Fire (Umbra & Aether) no longer uses mana, cannot be recast until the projectile lands, can be controlled/redirected when no enemy is targeted, has 120 max speed (1.25s speed-up), prioritizes the player's facing target, and displays its homing target.

Swirl no longer deals additional damage per debuff swirled.
weapons.overview: Summoner's Codex is a support weapon in Project Remix. It became accessible for testing on June 29th, 2026.
weapons.tips:
[Playing]

- Always switch between modes to maximize your damage and healing, when playing with a pact or flow phoenix. Do the opposite for Stasis because stasis grants a constant buff to nearby allies.
- Aether and Umbra variants do not require good aim, meaning during fast paced fights, the homing flames will heal or damage allies respectively.
- Due to dual spellbook variants, Codex can be customized to suit the situation, with varying offensive or support builds available.
- You can always see inflicted status effects regardless of the variants of Codex, making it useful to hunt down enemies nearby.
- Swirl requires holding the wind on the ground to deal damage, and in some cases, can be placed on ramps or walls. Swirl deals more damage for each debuff on the enemy, meaning bringing debuff abilities such as Anti-Heal Potion helps Swirl deal more damage.
- Do not swirl an enemy if there are no status effects on them, as this wastes mana.
- Place pact birds near enemies for maximum damage, and place flow and stasis birds near you or allies for maximum utility and healing.
- Upon spawning or at 3 charges, cycling between all phoenix modes is a good way of dealing damage to groups of enemies, however be careful because you cannot summon another phoenix for 6 seconds.
- If there are multiple codex users on your team, codex can swirl multiple phoenixes at once and inflict multiple effects on enemies.
- Maximize damage and healing by using Fire and Life phoenixes, while Ice mode phoenix should be used to confirm kills or slow down a flag carrier in Fishing for Flags.

[Countering]

- Do not go for the phoenix unless the codex user is using Stasis, because killing a phoenix allows them to summon another one and inflict more debuffs on you, while replenishing their mana.
- Codex is especially vulnerable to high burst damage because they heal over time rather than instantaneously.
- Barriers and walls such as Bubble Barrier can prevent codex users for damaging you, however do beware of umbra which can attack barriers anyways.
- Using Prayer of Life halves the duration of multiple debuffs, and using Fae Circle shuts down their debuffs entirely.
- Fighting at a very close or far range is recommended to counter codex users because of their low dps up front and inability to attack at a range.
- Anti-Heal potions can make fighting a Codex user significantly easier due to the reduced healing they receive.
weapons.trivia:
- Summoner's Codex was the first weapon to receive Legendary skins, those being Fairy Lantern and Fae Lantern.
- It is the first weapon to feature a dual variant system, allowing the user to change their Primary Fire and the behavior of their Phoenix.
- Choosing the Umbra and Swirl technique, even while Flow is selected, causes the weapon to experience the support remix penalty as they are both supportive variant which heals allies
- Before its rework, Summoner's Codex had set techniques (see Legacy Summoner's Codex).
- It is possible to recreate the old techniques, including the removed Aetherpact.
- The Summoner's Flame effect used to be called Detonation and behaved differently. The affected player would explode for 60% of the damage dealt to them during the duration after it ended.
- During spellbook testing, the Umbra variant was referred to as Nether.
- Swirl, upon its release, had the summon follow selected enemies and shoot them until the enemies die, behaving similarly to pact but auto-followed players.
- Summoner's Codex's Umbra and Pact phoenix projectile attacks can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique.

weapons.overview: Superball is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:

- Superball retains its hitbox and damage for some time while bouncing, which makes this weapon good in small enclosed areas.
- Due to low cooldown on its Primary Fire, you can hold Primary Fire to give constant attack without punishment.
- Predict the enemy movement to get more direct hits and deal more damage.
- Try to aim slightly higher to hit further.
- While using Hurl, utilize the Secondary attack to give Dazed effects first. And then quickly do Primary Fire to get bonus damage from its passive.
- You can use Star Fragment to give longerDazed effects and dishing out good amounts of damage.
[Countering]
- Avoid getting into enclosed areas.
- Being mid-air and further from Superball users will make them have harder time to hit you.
- Being agile and unpredictable at movement will mess up Superball user's aim.
- Using Body: Small or Drifter perk will greatly decrease Superball users chances to hit you.

weapons.overview: Tommy Gun is a ranged weapon in Project Remix.
weapons.tips:
- Tommy Gun is a very straightforward weapon. It's simple, quick, and versatile. There's not a lot of abilities that are bad to pair with it.
- New Vegas sacrifices headshots for the ability to cripple limbs. Use the specialized ADS to pick off important targets and cripple them.
[Playing]
- As with most other ranged weapons, aiming for headshots is key to maximizing your damage.
- Make a habit of reloading whenever you aren't firing! With a smaller ammo count that you can easily chew through, you don't want to be caught reloading in the middle of a fight.
- With New Vegas, Targetting the arms in particular is incredibly useful, as the player will drop their weapon and be unable to attack or use secondary fire. This is particularly useful against Brace users, as they won't be able to block attacks for a while.
[Countering]
- Tommy Gun isn't equipped for close quarters combat. Approaching them with any Melee weapon can dispose of them rather easily.
- Jump and be unpredictable with your movements to make them miss their headshots.
[Recommended Loadouts]
Default Loadout

Community submitted loadouts!
weapons.trivia:
- The New Vegas technique is a reference to Fallout, in both name and mechanic sake. It is similar to the V.A.T.S, where the player can target and deal damage to specific limbs.
- Tommy Gun's bullets can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

weapons.overview: Zombie Staff is an explosive weapon in Project Remix. It was released on October 25th, 2025.
weapons.tips:
- If you have multiple zombies and want to store them all quickly, press R! (or whatever you set your reload keybind to.)
- If your zombies are focusing someone, keep in mind that they will not lose agro. If an enemy is way too quick for your zombies to catch up, recall and resummon them. (Or direct hit someone close by.)
- If you have multiple zombies summoned, recalling them one by one is better for self healing as pressing R all at once makes you lose the total healing overtime. Micromanage em zombies!
- Position yourself from melee players from a decent distance, far enough for them to think about attacking you or your zombies. Directly hit them at least once then back off.
- You are basically nothing without your zombies, so pairing a damage ability can help to regain some charges quick. (Bloxxy radar works too!)
[Playing]
- If you only have 1 Servant stored/summoned, do everything in your power to not lose it, losing it means you basically cut a chunk out of your total dps and getting it some souls back will be way harder!
- Try and have zombies constantly focusing someone, having them be 50% slower isn't exactly the best thing is it?
- If the enemy happens to ignore the Servants and go after you, force them to acknowledge the servants by summoning them up close/going back to your hoard.
[Countering]
- If your a melee, try and bum rush the Zombie staff user at all times to not let them gain any more souls. Do keep in mind that the servants plus the M1 can pack quite the punch so attack with caution. If you can, kill a Servant with burst damage.
- If your ranged, just focus on the Zstaff user and not the servants, they can't do much since their M1 range is actually kinda short, letting you pick them off quickly if you got the distance.
weapons.trivia:
- The Zombie Staff is the first weapon to have an ability alter with a remix.
- When dancing, the Deathwalker Servants will dance along if they are not targeted on an enemy.
- There is a global cap of 6 summoned zombies
- Zombie Staff's blasts can be caught by Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique. See here for more information.

Draw a random card for special buffs
