==( Bugfixes )==

Major performance fixes

 Fixed an issue where the server would softlock at the end of rounds

Fixed an issue where commentator small dialogue wouldn't show up

 Fixed an issue where wall climbing wouldn't climb backwards to avoid ledges

Fixed an issue where Hyperlaser Gun kill effects wouldn't play

 ==( Changes )==

Big text will now appear upon being autobalanced to the opposite team

 Hitmarker sounds will now be affected by enemy health percentage

Staff of Life sounds are now affected by ally health percentage

 Updated Pistol's firing animation

Adjusted the temporary WIP gun reload animation speeds to match reload time

Bullets and projectiles now have effects upon hitting the ocean

 Rainy/cloudy weather has been temporarily disabled to respect the current season

Added tree leaves wind movement (can be disabled in Video settings)

 Chainlink fences can now be wall climbed

 ==( Balancing (General) )==

Healthpacks can no longer used while under the effects of Anti-Heal

 Quick Kick self knockback has been reduced by 25%

 Max swimming time has been reduced from 3 to 2 seconds

Swimming now slows your horizontal speed when moving too fast

 Dazed movement speed decrease has been reduced from -65% to -50%

 Time Bomb can no longer be thrown through enemy barriers

Poison Mist can no longer be thrown through enemy barriers

 Bleed/damage over time effects are now cleansed from debuff immunity

 Health perk Body: Large now prevents incoming critical headshots

 ==( Balancing (Gamemodes) )==

Crowned players can no longer be invisible

Crowned players can no longer be charmed

 Subspace Takeover return speed has been increased by 13%

Subspace Takeover objective no longer has glass walls and can be passed through

 ==( Balancing (Weapons) )==

Tommy Gun damage falloff multiplier has been increased from -35% to -50%

Tommy Gun bullet size has been reduced from 0.4 to 0.2

 Minigun speed penalty has been reduced from -50% to -45%

Minigun now additionally reduces jump height

 Pistol bullet size has been reduced from 0.6 to 0.4

 ==( Balancing (Support Weapons) )==

Bloxy Cola overhealth can no longer be built up and now only gains a burst of 25 from the first apply

Bloxy Cola now additionally slowly generates 10 overhealth over time (max 60)

Bloxy Cola aim height compensation has been slightly reduced

 Magician's Tophat Sleight Gambit now applies anti-heal to enemies BELOW 50% health

Magician's Tophat Sleight Gambit anti-heal duration has been increased from 3 to 4 seconds

 Staff of Life now hears damage ticks from your target without needing to use Secondary Fire with the Divine Strength variant

 ==( Balancing (Remix Abilities) )==

Aerial Support helicopter speed has been increased from 120 to 130

Aerial Support air control has been reduced by 50%

Aerial Support now drops the sniper rifle upon losing the helicopter

Aerial Support helicopter health has been increased from 800 to 1000

Fixed an issue where Aerial Support would lose the enemy laser upon scoping in

 Crimson Katana bleed damage has been reduced from 15 to 10 per second

Crimson Katana slash damage has been reduced from 17 to 16

Crimson Katana lockout duration has been decreased from 4 to 3 seconds

 Remote Airstrike ammo has been reduced from 12 to 8

 ==( Balancing (Abilities) )==

Bloxy Radar now prevents players from being invisible

Bloxy Radar revealed duration has been decreased from 12 to 8 seconds

 Portal Pair cooldown has been reduced from 4 to 2 seconds

 Invisibility removal immunity duration has been reduced from 1 to 0.5 seconds

 Megawatt Fencing deploy speed has been reduced by 25%

Pocket Heal II cooldown has been reduced from 8 to 6 seconds

 Jetpack vertical speed is now capped at the force it grants (40)

updates.author: Unknown
updates.content:
==( Maps )==

Maps will no longer be vote-able twice in a row



Zombie knockback has been reduced from 30 to 15

Kin storm radius has been decreased from 500 to 300

Kin storm rotate distance has been increased from 500 to 700

Kin storm origin has been moved



Titanic water rise speed has been increased by 2x

Creed Town rooftops are no longer slippery



The following maps have been majorly adjusted to have more cover and divisions :

Glass Houses
Haunted Mansion
Plates of Fate
Raving Raceway
Builder's Bedroom
Sunken Heights
ROBLOX Titanic
Crossroads



==( Additions )==

Scored kills/assists are now only granted if a player dealt more than 60 damage to the target

Assists are now merged with Kills on the leaderboard

Damage Dealt has been added to the leaderboard



Ability cooldowns are now visible in the selection menu

Remix Ability build costs are now visible in the selection menu

Player weapon levels will now be displayed on the victory screen

A charge meter has been added to Superball and Katana's Moonlit Veil variant



An option to disable ability jump bindings has been added in Gameplay settings

Players will now be kicked for AFKing throughout an entire round



Added seasonal Summer outfits for Red & Blue which will rotate daily

Maps will now have introduction dialogue from Red & Blue



A new Healing ability has been added: Purifying Prayer!

Briefly take a short prayer stance to provide self and nearby allies with debuff immunity
Provides debuff immunity for 5 seconds alongside 1 second of damage immunity
Additionally heals for 15% of max health and kickstarts passive regen



A new Damage ability has been added: Sidearm!

Quickly swap to a weak pistol for emergencies or to finish off opponents
Fire up to 12 rounds
Activate again to unequip early
Cooldown is reduced based on unused bullets

updates.content:
==( COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENT )==

hii!! we're tired


we go in and read ALL of your suggestions daily and we hear everything the community says and take it all into consideration

HOWEVER the channels are treated like i'm being ignorant to everything that's said despite making constant consistent adjustments and changes to the game daily that directly correlates to what the current state of the game is AS somebody who genuinely plays the game myself and sees issues and non-issues myself! i specifically hear about parties and i FULLY understand the concern and i've been working to improve team balancing on the daily with different algorithms/systems/mechanics but it's incredibly discouraging not having any chances to work on it further by the community! if you would like to help out make suggestions similar to "party matchmaking could be better if you ..." rather than "remove it nobody likes it"


we do not appreciate hearing "they don't care" and "our suggestions are unheard anyways!"

not every suggestion makes it in and not every suggestion makes it in immediately, and most suggestions actually influence the actions towards the game and tells us what the game needs! when we as a team go into the chat, we are not coming in so you can @ us with links to your suggestion! we have already seen it and are only in the chat to have fun and talk to the community outside of work! most suggestions do not recieve replies because debating and talking about balancing/design decisions is EXHAUSTING and pointing us to your suggestion will not help your case in the slightest!


we respect discussions about balancing! however:

lately the chat has been less about talking about fun builds/loadouts/characters it's been excessively dumped with negative responses and hyperanalysis leaving us and many other people who just play for fun (the way the game is designed to be played) discouraged to be active in the chat at all!


if you have an issue with balancing or the game, make a suggestions post and just leave us to read it!

if you are replying to a suggestion, please keep it civil and don't be a jerk and discourage people from posting!! that's all and just have fun with the game!! we are not a studio, we are three pals in a band having fun and we're not going to get things right the first time but we get to it

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
==( Bugfixes )==

Fixed an issue where robot deploy boxes wouldn't deal damage

Fixed an issue where kill zones would immediately kill players upon exiting rather than having a minimum time of 1.5 seconds

Fixed an issue where kill effects wouldn't work on enemy NPCs

Fixed a missing sound file for party invite notifications

 Fixed an issue where Shotgun's sensitivity would be locked while using the Compression variant

Fixed an issue where Fists' Battering Ram charge damage would be decreased if a wall was hit

Fixed a wall climb detection issue where small ledges wouldn't be climbable such as the edges in Plates of Faith

Fixed a slight music track looping issue

Improved performance with projectiles

TIX reward from kills has been reduced from 50 to 25

Environmental deaths will now ignore minimum required damage for assists allowing most knockback effects to grant environmental kills

 Bullets and projectiles will no longer use width when detecting static surfaces

Healing self-damage inflicted by the helee will no longer add towards the Healing Dealt stat or Remix Ability charge

Added a behavior warning under the flag option in The Armory's profile page

[Misc. Perk] Mastery Roulette will now randomly equip owned skins

Rain now follows wind direction rather than straight down

Added new kill feed colors for self and group members

Adjusted bullet effects

Adjusted bullet effect placement from guns

Reduced Superball zoom while charged

Reduced Slingshot's Tri-Shot variant fire zoom

BALANCING PATCH TO GET BACK INTO THE SWINGATHINGS (14)

==( Bugfixes / Changes )==

Fixed an issue where [Ability] Sidearm's bullet tracer didn't line up with the weapon viewmodel

Fixed an issue where construct health wouldn't sync for new players joining in

Fixed an issue where dash abilities could clip through forcefields and constructs

Fixed an issue that prevented players from spawning in during team gamemodes

Removed low health screen color effect



Requests can now be repeated if all requests have been completed and all request loot has been recieved



==( Balancing )==

Remix Ability passive charge rate has been increased from 15 to 20 per second

Remix Abilities will no longer gain passive charge during team gamemodes if the player's team is in the lead

Remix abilities have always been intended to be a big turnaround, but rewarding the winning team who already gets kills with remix abilities was ironic for what they are. This should help losing teams recover quickly and use remix abilities the way they were intended.


Max party size has been decreased from 3 to 2 players

Allowing players to have trio parties allowed too much power over servers with the possible team combos. This change should help prevent team balancing from being overaffected by one group.


[Remix Ability] Transmorph Ray's Enlarged buff damage reduction has been reduced from -70% to -50%

[Remix Ability] Transmorph Ray's Enlarged buff damage increase is now capped at +70% (up to 2x)

Having a player enlarged over 2x already grants a massive range/hitbox increase and doesn't warrant an instant kill damage bonus. The damage reduction decrease is mainly to resolve the issue that enlarged players are near unkillable when paired with both high damage reduction and increased damage output. This should allow enlarged players to be punished more for their increased hitbox size.


[Remix Ability] Remote Airstrike landing delay has been reduced from 1.5 to 1.1 seconds

This remix ability has been way too predictable and avoidable. This change should help narrow down kills and act as more of a surprise for enemy players.


[Remix Ability] Aerial Support will now be forced to crash upon recieving the Crown in Crowned gamemodes

This remix ability allowed too much safety in the air while crowned. This should also force more usage of the helicopter explosion rather than the single target sniper rifle.


[Remix Ability] Bladed Tutu animation and sounds have been adjusted for more predictability

Bladed Tutu has always been an AOE death circle that put it leagues above other remix abilities solely because of the instant cast. This should put it more in line aswell as giving it an extra starting dash.


[Ability] Charming Dote is now a player lockon rather than a projectile ability

Having to aim a slow projectile at allies with an ability meant to be used during dire circumstances made this ability underperform. This change should help alleviate this issue.


==( !! EXTRA INFO !! )==

[Remix Ability] Teddy Trap will now force the victim into the usual first person camera

Teddy Trap had too much of an advantage over third person weapons because the teddy bear viewmodel was always placed in front of the character, always out of sight. This change may be reverted because snapping to first person makes the ability way more obvious, but I'll have to see how it goes.


[Standard Weaponry] Linked Sword secondary fire cooldown is now halved if no enemy was hit

[Standard Weaponry] Linked Sword secondary fire base damage has been increased from 60 to 75

Linked sword had too much of an extreme punishment when missing the secondary fire lunge attack and always seemed to underperform damage-wise compared to other weapons. These changes should additionally help Linked Sword's secondary fire be more versatile as either an opener or a movement utility.


[Weapon] Ninja Whip's Chasing Fang variant will no longer remove the movement effect when in range

[Weapon] Ninja Whip's Chasing Fang variant minimum pull distance has been decreased from 8 to 4

Chasing Fang has had an issue where the player moving out of range would leave the user stuck in the position where the enemy used to be. This change additionally prevents the user from suddenly having zero momentum at the end of the pull, allowing slightly further mobility.


[Weapon] Laser Scythe secondary fire projectile size has been increased from 1.5 to 3

[Weapon] Laser Scythe secondary fire projectile will no longer use bullet width for detecting static geometry

[Weapon] Laser Scythe secondary fire teleportation will now have a separate hitbox to prevent clipping through tiny spaces

Laser Scythe's secondary fire projectile was changed to prevent clipping through tiny spaces, but this change also affected the weapon's performance. This should return it to how it played before, but with an extra measure to prevent map glitching.


[Weapon] Slingshot primary fire cooldown has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.45 seconds

Slingshot's primary fire has always been ignorable by both teams with the low damage output. This small adjustment will hopefully better adapt slingshot's overall power to fight alongside other ranged weapons.


[Remix Ability] Aerial Support sniper rifle recoil is now reduced when scoped

Players would often ignore the scoped feature because it always felt more consistent outside of it. With reduced recoil to match the hipfiring recoil, it should feel a lot more consistent and hopefully allow players to use the helicopter's range potential.

==( Extra Note )==

The community TOYBOX weapon skins will be coming soon!

For now, if you managed to score a win with your weapon design, congratulations! You will recieve the following items:

Unique title - Toybox Soldier

(Winners will recieve both sets of items.)


==( Additions )==

Nearly every bit of in-game UI has been completely overhauled!

Please enjoy our hard work to really allow the style of Project Remix to shine!
More adjustments and overhauls will come at a future date!


We are now introducing customizable namecards!

Namecards will be shown during your victims' death screens and the victory screen!
In the armory's profile page, there will now be a new option to customize your namecard using stickers and styles earned from rewards and the loot lockers!
You will be able to select a base style and place stickers however you'd like!


Added new customizable locational pings to the communication menu!

Let your allies know that there's an enemy, that you can heal them, or that they should go somewhere!
Customizable in the armory's profile page


Loadout items can now be right clicked to favorite them and will be moved to a Favorites category!

With the game getting more and more perks, abilities, and weapons every update this should help alleviate the amount of scrolling and looking around for your items!


[Weapon] Minigun will now alter [Ability] Trowel into Barricade!

Build a windowed steel barricade for cover or to block off opponents
R to rotate the placement position
Additionally builds barbed wire above walls
Owned walls are see-through up close
300 wall health


[Perk] Bonus Health has been reworked:

Gain +25 overhealth when out of combat


[Perk] Swiftcast has been reworked:

Ability cooldowns for non-movement abilities will be reset upon landing a killing blow upon player


[Perk] Drifter has been reworked:

Using a movement ability will increase movement speed by 25% for 1.25 seconds


[Perk] Angelic Descent has been reworked:

Hold down Jump to slow your falling at the cost of Action Points
Fall damage is fully negated


A new Health perk has been added: Taunt!

Emoting for 0.75 seconds with an enemy looking at you will heal 75 health


A new Health perk has been added: Abundance!

Healing an ally with full health will 'overheal' up to +30 additional overhealth


A new Health perk has been added: Mutual Benefit!

When owned overhealth on yourself or an ally is damaged, heal the victim for 50% of the damage taken


A new Utility perk has been added: Impervious!

All effects whether positive or negative will have halved duration


A new Utility perk has been added: Susceptible!

All effects whether positive or negative will have doubled duration


A new Utility perk has been added: Ghostwalker!

Turn into a 75 health free-roaming ghost upon reaching 1 health and be resurrected after surviving for 5 seconds


A new Damage perk has been added: Slam Dunk!

Quick Kicking an enemy further than 15 studs off the ground will throw them down to the ground and drain all of their Action Points


A new Movement perk has been added: Rebound!

When inflicting knockback upon an enemy player, also inflict the same force on yourself

updates.author: Unknown
updates.content:
==( Additions )==

[Weapon] A new Explosive weapon has been added: Zombie Staff!

Harvest souls to raise undead minions! Who cares if it's necromancy? It's cool.

Hold down Primary Fire to charge up focused eldritch blasts, damaging enemies and healing minions at the cost of mana

Landing a direct hit using Primary Fire will focus minion aggression onto the target

Firing at a surface will direct minions who aren't attacking an enemy to that location

Killing enemy players or zombies will absorb their essence as a Soul Charge (max 3) and recover a moderate amount of mana


The Deathwalker's prized possession... well, actually just a replica imbued with only a mimicry of her actual power.
"The Deathspeaker silenced her to test her loyalty, but her true unwavering will be eternal; to overtake the throne of the Korblox."
(Alters remix ability: Soul Cleave)

-50 max health


[Weapon] Zombie Staff comes with the starting technique: Puppet Master!

Hold down Secondary Fire to use a Soul Charge and place up to 3 allied Deathwalker Servants
150 health, automatically chases and attacks the nearest enemy within range
Secondary Fire can additionally target owned Deathwalker Servants or wild zombies to recollect their being as a Soul Charge
Reload to recall all Deathwalker Servants as Soul Charges


A new match mechanic has been added: Crowned!

In FFA, King of the Hill and Subspace gamemodes: If the top player on the leaderboard has 14+ kills, they will be Crowned!
InTeam Deathmatch modes: If the score difference is 6 or further, the top player on the winning team will be Crowned!

Killing a Crowned player will give your team +15 gamemode points (outside of Subspace gamemodes) and Divine Veil for 8 seconds

Additionally, after a Crowned player is killed, the round will be extended by 20 seconds if there is more than 1 minute remaining

There will be a 40 second cooldown before another Crowned player will be picked

Crowned players can be healed and defended by their team

Not included in [Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags

Disabled in private servers

among our disagreement to the AI-oriented direction that ROBLOX has been taking, our team has recently discovered that both TUNNELER and Project Remix have been opted in since 2024, against our knowledge and consent, to being fed to ROBLOX's new AI models & features

as developers who have been on the platform for 10+ years, this is very infuriating and a huge betrayal of our trust for the platform. we were lenient before hoping that ROBLOX would see that the AI features were extremely exploitative, though as it is now from the announcement of upcoming features, this discovery and how hidden it really was - we cannot be sure of the safety of our assets & code while using the platform

while we will still be active in the discord handling reports, moderation and additionally continuing hotfix & adjustment patches for Project Remix, we are announcing another temporary hiatus for the major update in the meantime until there are increased options to protect ours & others work

[Weapon] Fists attack speed bonus while Enraged has been decreased from +50% to +25%

HM Comment: Fists' gimmick with Enraged was fun to play around but had too much power for the newer additions of being able to get Enraged without Barbaric Roar.


[Weapon] Fists' Multi-attack press minimum timing has been increased from 0.07 to 0.14 seconds

[Weapon] Fists' Multi-attack damage has been reduced from 66% to 55% of base damage

[Weapon] Fists' Multi-attack cooldown has been decreased from 6 to 4 seconds

HM Comment: Fists' Multi-attack was strong but incredibly hard to pull off causing players to both be deterred from playing the technique AND dislike playing against it. These changes should make the weapon feel smoother to pull off at the sake of having less maximum damage potential, similar to the changes made to bullet-based weapons.


[Weapon] Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique will no longer have increased/adjusted firing speed based on the next projectile's ammo cost and will now fire bullets in a shotgun-like blast for every projectile up to 2 ammo cost

HM Comment: for example - stellar tune's bullets have a 0.25 ammo cost so having 8 would make a shotgun blast of bullets, while bullets cost 1 which would blast 2 bullets, and so on. this technique is really cool as a concept but seems to be held back by the sheer variety of projectiles in the game!!! this change should make it so that capturing bullets no matter what kind will still hold power while also making it consistent with the tracking of the base weapon.


[Weapon] Skateboard's Primary Fire can now be held down instead of requiring button mashing

[Weapon] Skateboard skating will now cost Action Points even without being Crowned but the cost has been reduced from -20 to -10 per second

[Weapon] Skateboard Action Point regain from hitting players has been increased from 10 to 20

HM Comment: this shouldn't be taken as a nerf but a rebalance for players who use Skateboard strictly for its mobility without investing into attacking other players while also adding a better reason & reward to switch between modes AND adding more ability interactions with the weapon itself.


[Weapon] Rotary Chaingun will no longer have bullet accuracy while hitting Warden's Axe

HM Comment: while the idea is fun, the axe's damage combined with headshots is way too much damage. this should put it more in line while also keeping the axe's interaction with the weapon's Primary Fire.


[Ability] Flight cooldown has been adjusted from 6-7.5 seconds to a flat 6 seconds

HM Comment: it's no secret that Flight is a very strong and versatile movement ability, however it seems as though the actual flight part of it was already considered balanced previously when it was a 6 second cooldown. the previous cooldown nerf was only targeted toward the tap-jolt movement, so this change should put both parts in the correct spot.


[Ability] Tranquilizer Dart cooldown has been increased from 8 to 10 seconds

HM Comment: not the cleanest adjustment for the power it has when paired with other things, but it's just a small adjustment to start off with for now to see how it affects things


[Ability] Gravity Gun will now have a double equip penalty

HM Comment: while the ability alone isn't the strongest thing on its own, being able to be used consecutively disrupts our balancing around it.


Dying within 1.5 seconds of using a Remix Ability will now refund all used charge

HM Comment: i didn't want to include this for a long time because i wanted to see if people could get into learning when & where to use your remix ability, but i understand this game has a lot of times where ping can get the better of you and it's never a good feeling losing such a big thing so easily

Adjustments patch (90)


Fixed an issue where [Ability] Icarus could be used while under the effects of [Ability] Black Hand



[Weapon] Slingshot's "Thanks!" technique will now recieve 40% damage resistance while using Secondary Fire

HM Comment: the previous change added a lot more power to this technique, but the problem lies in that it's still too easy to be a sitting duck and get blown up in the heat of battle! this change should make it much less punishing to use your net, even if for a short period.


[Weapon] Laser Scythe's Primary Fire hits will now self-heal for 25 health

HM Comment: while this weapon was very strong and capable before, compared to other weapons now it's way too punishing to play without being completely perfect. This change should not only boost its survivability back more toward how it was designed to have, it should also alleviate the pressure of having to hit every Secondary Fire shot.


[Weapon] Staff of Life's Surge technique mana cost has been increased from 25 to 28.5 per second

[Weapon] Staff of Life's Surge technique will now have an additional effect: After releasing Secondary Fire, heal your target in a burst for 40% of the healing done during use

HM Comment: with the global healing reduction from healer stacking, the healing reduction from taking damage and the healing reduction when multiple sources heal one target, Surge has been on the weaker side of things compared to the game it was designed for before. This change shouldn't be too strange and oppressive as the mana usage for Surge is one of the highest costs out of all the mana-based abilities.


[Remix Ability] Transmorph Ray will no longer be rechargeable until Enlarged has ended

[Remix Ability] Transmorph Ray's Enlarged effect will now have 50% less influence over movement scaling

HM Comment: ultimately while it's fun to combo, fighting against Enlarged players with the effect stacked or not is a huge hurdle and this movement change should make them less jarring to track and attack in fights


The following Remix Abilities have had their timing adjusted for the newly added death refund system:

Bubble Barrier: 1.5s -> 0s (disabled)
Crimson Katana: 1.5s -> 0.5s
Teddy Trap: 1.5s -> 0.25s
Divine Veil: 1.5s -> 0.5s
Fae Circle: 1.5s -> 1s
HM Comment: while this change is great for game flow, some Remix Abilities with wind-ups have been indirectly buffed. These adjustments should tighten the window between 'accident' and 'reckless,' while the change to Fae Circle has a little more wiggle room since the real value from it comes from the duration. Bubble Barrier is an instant-cast that stays after death, so it doesn't need the refund in the first place.


Crowned behavior has been adjusted:

Spawns when a player reaches 14+ kills and teams have a 6+ point difference with a 60 second cooldown -> Spawns when a team has a 6+ point difference for more than 40 seconds
Given to the player with the most kills -> Given to the player with the most kills or mitigation or healing (250 points of mit/healing is considered 1 kill)
HM Comment: crowned is a finnicky thing to have in the game but lately conversations have arose where it feels targeted or unfair because of how often it pops up when it doesn't need to and how it's unfair to have it only target players with high kills when there are also other methods to carry your team to victory

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
==( Additions )==

Updated [Weapon] Laser Finger Pointers sounds

Updated [Weapon] General's .45's sounds

Updated [Weapon] Burst Rifle's sounds

Updated [Weapon] E.T.Death's sounds

Updated [Weapon] Shotgun sounds



[Weapon] Skateboard has been fully reworked into the Explosive category!

A skateboard and spraypaint combo allowing absurd mobility and air attacks. What's not to like?
Primary Fire will spray out a paint burst, dealing quick damage while redirecting your momentum
Hold down Secondary Fire to skate at the cost of Action Points, hold down JUMP mid-air against a wall to wallride and release to do a trick
Doing tricks or hitting enemies with your board will restore paint charges
Enemy kills will fully restore Action Points
Allows the use of Throwables without interrupting skating


[Weapon] Summoner's Codex will now have dual technique/variant equipping:

The weapon's techniques have been split up and you can now change your Primary Fire and Secondary Fire separately! Keep in mind that changing your Technique will alter your weapon's category causing you to have dynamic different role passives.


[Weapon] Summoner's Codex has been given an additional new Ranged Technique: Umbra!

Primary Fire will send out homing magic to damage enemies
Uses mana


[Weapon] Summoner's Codex has been given an additional new Utility variant: Stasis!

Your summon will create an aura to buff allies
Buffs allies within the field:

Fire - Increases attack power by 15%

Ice - Reduces damage taken by 15%

Life - Grants health regeneration



[Weapon] A new Ranged weapon has been added: Wind Azura!

A wind-imbued hand fan originated from the Astral Isles capable of summoning winds & tornadoes
Primary Fire hits will inflict a stack of Winded onto enemies (up to 3), each one increasing the victim's damage taken from all sources by +5%
Additionally restores mana based on 25% of wind damage dealt
HM Comment - oraclespades: I spent a lot of time & procrastination trying to make this weapon special for my first ever developer drop, i hope you all enjoy it!
my thought process is to make a dps focused on objective claiming & have techniques that give different ways of handling that - through knockback, shielding, or damage
ps, the skins upon launch will be the default for all new skins (for all weapons) in the future, each having 3 recolors per skin. I hope you all are excited for more customization as well!


[Weapon] Wind Azura comes with the base technique: Whirlwind!

Secondary will summon an astral tornado at the cost of mana
Deals increased damage and knockback based on the victim's Winded stacks


[Weapon] Wind Azura comes with the following Defense technique: Aiding Tempest!

Secondary Fire will create a hollow vortex to trap enemies with you while protecting from outside attacks
Deflects bullets & projectiles and pulls enemies inside

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Hotfix patch (3)


[Weapon] Skateboard can no longer exceed 100% speed while skating

HM Comment - meal: speed buffs and different mechanics make skateboard way too unpredictable than what the rework was intended


[Weapon] Summoner's Codex' Stasis variant Life phoenix healing has been decreased from 40 to 30

[Weapon] Wind Azura's Whirlwind technique will no longer inflict knockback after bouncing off a wall

updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Hotfix patch (4)


Reduced Healing applied from attacking other players has been increased from -40% to -60% healing received

Reduced Healing applied from attacking other players duration has been decreased from 2 to 1.25 seconds

HM Comment: this change should make it less of a hurdle to fight against teams of multiple healers. otherwise, if you are solo healing or using a self-healing weapon, this change shouldn't affect you too much since the duration counterbalance gives an opportunity for counterplay, especially since not having the support stack penalty gives you a fantastic amount of healing


[Weapon] Skateboard ram impact damage has been decreased from 50-100 to 45-90

[Weapon] Skateboard's Kickflip technique damage has been decreased from 50-100 to 45-90

HM Comment: while 150 health weapons will still get combo-d, this change is pretty much experimental to see how this weapon can go without being able to hit the 200 damage mark


[Weapon] Fists' Multi-attack technique will now grant 6 overhealth per hit (up to 100)

HM Comment: multi-attack's damage was decreased because i don't like the idea of weapons being impossibly hard to pick up and having insane damage output to counterbalance that, so i'm going to be moving toward giving it more of a fighting presence instead.


[Weapon] Fists' Brace technique range has been increased from 12 to 24

HM Comment: Brace has been underperforming for a while now and it's just too hard to keep up with your allies to protect them. this change should make the technique better to play without adjusting its damage reduction effect.


[Ability] Black Hand will now cancel [Weapon] Skateboard's skating

HM Comment: this is how it worked with pre-rework skateboard, some code was not ported to the new skating mechanic
updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (5)


Reduced Healing inflicted after attacking an enemy has been decreased from -60% to -50%

HM Comment - meal: the previous changes seemed to affect mid-combat healing too well making many healing sources fully null. going for a mid point seems to be the next step


[Remix Ability] Scarlet Aeonia cost has been decreased from 2250 to 1400

[Remix Ability] Scarlet Aeonia animation speed has been increased by 20%

[Remix Ability] Scarlet Aeonia size has been decreased by 40%

HM Comment: high cost remix abilities are a lot less used than ones that are quick to charge just because they're too strong at the cost of being extremely inactive. this is a small experiment to see how they fare being slightly weaker but easier to charge.
updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (6)


[Remix Ability] Scarlet Aeonia scale has been adjusted from -40% to -20%

[Remix Ability] Scarlet Aeonia cost has been increased from 1400 to 1600

HM Comment: meal - still experimenting, just trying a second adjustment before landing on a final result


[Ability] T.U.N.N.E.L.E.R. will no longer inflict knockback when placed on a non-destructible surface

HM Comment - meal: being able to be placed on any surface made the ability a lot more valuable but having full power basically made it too powerful for the fast wind-up it has.


[Weapon] Magician's Tophat primary fire damage has been increased from 12 to 16

HM Comment - meal: small adjustment to give it some more kick before the new M1 patch
updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (7)


[Weapon] Tommy Gun damage has been adjusted from 10.5-15.75 to 10.5-13.125

HM Comment: it seems like people like the utility where movement abilities give back ammo, but the weapon has been overperforming, so rather than removing that mechanic i'm adjusting the critical hit multiplier from +50% to +25%


[Weapon] Summoner's Codex' Pact variant damage has been decreased from 25 to 20

[Weapon] Summoner's Codex' Flow variant healing has been increased from 50 to 75

HM Comment: Pact gets way too much value on top of the damage debuffs while Flow hasn't gotten much usage, this shift should give more power to the weapon's support power rather than solo killing ability.


[Weapon] E.T.Death base damage has been adjusted from 20-30 to 25-30

[Weapon] E.T.Death's [Ability] Portal Gun ability alter duration has been increased from 3 to 4.5 seconds

HM Comment: against what a lot of people may say, this weapon is extremely punshing to play and this change should make the weapon less reliant on headshots in order to perform good. moving on, this change to the ability alter may seem like a buff, however having a longer duration forces the ability to be more of an investment with a longer cooldown.


[Weapon] Slipknot's Tempo technique arrow capacity have been increased from 12 to 24

[Weapon] Slipknot's Tempo arrow damage will now be decreased by 10%

HM Comment: this arrow capacity mechanic is to prevent this technique from being able to constantly spam high damaging arrows non-stop arrows at great range and to be more of a mid to melee range technique, however a lot of people have said that this severely limits the weapon. this change should make the weapon less restricting and in return have a lower output to compensate being easier to use.


[Weapon] Atmoblaster X-4 health penalty has been reduced from -50 to -25

HM Comment: atmoblasters previously had a great health penalty for what it can do at range, however now that the weapon's damage has been severely decreased alongside damage falloff being added, this weapon is forced to play at shorter range and no longer needs the effect, even if someone tries to airstall because the charge rate is also decreased from being airborne.
updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Hotfix patch (8)


[Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags will now recieve 40% less damage from the previous flag owner

[Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags will no longer be given to either off the previous 2 flag owners

HM Comment: this change will make it so there will no longer be a 'meta' build to getting the flag as fast as possible and be more team-oriented as well as no longer allow players to continuously get the flag and being able to stall to make the game mode last an infinite amount of time.
updates.threadTitle: ==( Additions )==

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Minor logs: Adjustments patch (9)


[Weapon] Tommy Gun has been moved to the Long Range category

Long Range weapon damage will now be reduced by up to 30% on enemies within 50 studs

HM Comment: Long Range hasn't exactly been a solid category until now. this shift will make the weapons less well-rounded at all distances and allow for more counterplay for weapons in other categories.


[Perk] Predator & Prey can no longer activate within 3 seconds of being in range of an ally

HM Comment: previously this perk was only tied to Reduced Healing to be disabled in combat, however with the recent changes to the duration of the effect this perk's health bonus has been popping up more frequently during fights. this change should solidify that the perk is not meant to be solely for free healing in the middle of fights.

Extra note from HM:
sometime soon i'd like to experiment in the PTB with removing body: large and body: small as perks and implementing them as default states for weapons, for example ban hammer, equinox blades or fists (weapons that have high health pools) would receive body: large's character size modifiers while weapons like katana, summoner's codex or atmoblaster x-4 would receive body: small's character size modifiers for their smaller HP pools. this would not include the perks' other effects like damage reduction or increased damage taken, but would help balance weapons a bit more other than purely adjusting health pools.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (10)


[Weapon] Tommy Gun damage falloff range while using Secondary Fire has been adjusted from 50-150 to 100-200

[Weapon] Paintball Gun damage falloff range has been adjusted from 100-200 to 125-250

[Weapon] General's .45 damage falloff range has been adjusted from 100-200 to 125-250

HM Comment: now that the long range categorized weapons are weaker up close, i can start adjusting values to make the weapons less punishing to play at their respective range

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Hotfix patch (11)


[Weapon] Sacrificial Censer lockout buildup from melee hits has been increased from 25 to 35

HM Comment: sacrificial censer has been on the weaker side of weapons, hopefully this change will give it more of a push toward being useful in battles.


[Map] Mad Tech Factory scale has been increased by 25%

[Map] Mad Tech Factory will now have teleporter pads at dead end locations

HM Comment: while these changes won't change the layout significantly like a 2nd floor would, we're a little busy doing other things and don't have time for a full map overhaul at the moment

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (12)


[Weapon] Slipknot's far damage multiplier has been increased from +20% to +40%

HM Comment: compared to other long range weapons, slipknot has the slowest projectile which causes it to be more lackluster when played from afar. this change should allow for more skill expression and play


[Weapon] Sacrificial Censer lockout buildup from melee hits has been decreased from 35 to 30

[Weapon] Sacrificial Censer will no longer automatically place a ritual from inflicting Lockout on a player and will now have their primary fire be upgraded to manually place a ritual within 70 studs

HM Comment: censer's ritual is its main damage source and mechanic, however after making the weapon's slowing and stunning effect more negligible, the ritual is very easily avoidable when placed directly on targets. this adjustment will allow for the weapon's user to have more control and skill expression to be able to predict player movement.


[Ability] Trowel walls will now share 50% damage taken to additional nearby walls

HM Comment: this adjustment will give trowel the same logic as healing orb and barrier shield making it less oppressive to play against without having to change its fundamentals.


[Ability] Healing Orb cooldown has been decreased from 6 to 4.5 seconds

HM Comment: after the change where it no longer tracks its target it's had a lot less value, so i'll be adjusting it to have more presence than re-implementing what players didn't like to fight against


[Ability] Lockout Curse can now be detonated mid-air by pressing the ability key again

HM Comment: this change should make the ability more interesting to use and play as well as open up opportunities to halt flying players


[Ability] Sidearm cooldown has been decreased from 8 to 6 seconds

[Ability] Sidearm damage falloff multiplier has been reduced from -65% to -50%

HM Comment: sidearm hasn't had much use over other abilities because of its lack of utility, i'm hoping this smaller adjustment will make it less clunky to use before moving on to adjusting further values


[Ability] Grappling Hook cooldown has been decreased from 10 to 8 seconds

[Ability] Gravity Disruptor cooldown has been decreased from 8 to 6 seconds

[Ability] Black Hand cooldown will now be reduced to 1.5 seconds if no enemy was hit

HM Comment: these abilities have been underutilized because their conditions or restrictions are too harsh for them to be active abilities, so hopefully these changes will give them more substance over ones that are easier to use

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Hotfix patch (13)


Fixed an issue where [Remix Ability] Aerial Support was an aerial target for [Ability] Lightning Spear



[Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags: When the flag carrier is killed, rather than dropping a flag for both teams, the flag will now be given to whoever dealt the most damage to the flag carrier

HM Comment: this change should make the gamemode more fast paced aswell as give less control from weapons that deal high damage toward still targets.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content: update: i was finally able to recreate the issue on my end and fishin for flags should now be fully functional!!

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (14)


[Weapon] Dual Rocket Launchers' rocket damage has been adjusted from 30-40 to a flat 45

[Weapon] Dual Rocket Launchers' health bonus has been decreased from +50 to +25

HM Comment: this adjustment should make the weapon's rockets more reliable in fights. at the same time, i'm lowering the amount of survivability the weapon has to match its new killing power as more of a damage dealer than a tank.


[Weapon] Grenade Launcher's Volatile Grenades technique will now the detonator as Secondary Fire

[Weapon] Grenade Launcher's Volatile Grenades bounciness has been reduced from 50% to 25%

[Weapon] Grenade Launcher's Volatile Grenades lifetime has been increased from 0.4 to 1.2 seconds

HM Comment: as per people's request, i'm going to start adjusting grenade launcher to move away from the original technique back in 2020 be more in-line with the other weapons and be balanced around having one.


[Weapon] Laser Finger Pointers' Advanced Targeting base damage multiplier has been reduced by 25%

HM Comment: this change will make it so that the weapon has a damage basis than the original variant but still have a +25% damage potential from crits.


[Ability] Lightning Spear will now halt movement on hit

HM Comment: lightning spear was designed around being able to counter fast moving targets, however with the previous change alongside all the daze removals it's been more damage-oriented. the return of this feature should make the ability more interesting to play.


[Ability] Black Hand duration has been decreased from 2.5 to 1.5 seconds

[Ability] Black Hand will now halt all of the victim's movement on hit

HM Comment: a lot of people have a disdain for this ability because of its inescapable amount of control. this adjustment to make it more in-line with lightning spear's newer mechanic should make it more modernized to do what it needs to do without feeling oppressive.


[Remix Ability] Bladed Tutu will no longer lose momentum and continue spinning even when running into walls

[Remix Ability] Bladed Tutu duration has been decreased from 6 to 5 seconds

HM Comment: for a while, this remix ability has been relatively weak compared to other ones that can fully one-shot targets. this adjustment should rapidly improve its damage output no matter the map, but in return i'll be reducing its duration slightly in case it becomes too oppressive.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (15)


[Weapon] Grenade Launcher changes reverted

HM Comment: apparently something was worse than nothing so we'll be reverting this change until further notice


[Weapon] Dual Rocket Launchers' Locked & Loaded technique will no longer have a bonus damage passive

HM Comment: with the previous damage increase, this weapon exceeded the damage potential we'd like for it, so this will bring it more down toward where it originally was.


[Ability] Black Hand pull strength has been increased from 30 to 60

HM Comment: after the ability's duration was severely decreased, black hand has not been countering movement like it originally was. this change should give it some more power without making it feel as oppressive as it was before.


[Remix Ability] Soul Cleave will now reduce enemy's max health by 50 for 5 seconds

HM Comment: while anti-heal is effective, this remix ability needs a little more to be the sustain counter, now also toward damage reduction or overhealth buffs.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (16)


Outlines will now be more visible on players using their Remix Ability

The Crowned status will now be cleared if the crowned player's team loses the lead

Turning off Minor Effects in settings will now disable explosion forces (+performance)



[Weapon] Zombie Staff zombies can now break through terrain over trying to climb in certain pathing situations

HM Comment: this change should make the zombies more reliable on maps focused around walls


[Weapon] Skateboard health penalty has been increased from -25 to -50

HM Comment: a small adjustment to bring its survivability down more toward its mobility capabilities.


[Weapon] Lighting Wand health penalty has been decreased from -50 to -25

HM Comment: compared to the other low health weapons, lighting wand has a much lower mobility potential and doesn't need as much of a penalty.


[Weapon] Linked Sword's Paladin's Oath technique damage has been decreased from 9 to 7.5

[Weapon] Linked Sword's Paladin's Oath technique secondary fire can now be placed on allies, automatically triggering early if under 30% health

HM Comment: i'm rebalancing this weapon to be more focused on being support-focused rather than combo focused, reverting to how it was originally designed but slightly improved.


[Perk] Assassin's Gambit will no longer grant a +30% damage boost after 1.5 seconds of being invisible

[Perk] Assassin's Gambit move speed bonus has been increased from +40% to +80% while invisible

HM Comment: it's an interesting concept, but similarly to Linked Sword's old golden vow ability alter, people would rather not be the victim of a one-shot combo.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (17)


Invisibility will now only create visible effects while standing still

HM Comment: this change should make Invisibility more of a utility rather than based on if you're lucky enough for the enemies to not see you... while invisible.


Crowned points reward has been reduced from 14 to 7

Crowned will no longer grant Divine Veil to enemy teams when killed

Crowned players will now be immune to being crowned twice in a row

Crowned will now grant +66% remix ability charge to enemy teams when killed

HM Comment: this change is aimed toward improving the crowned system and making it less risky as a crowned user and allowing the enemy teams to be resourceful and earn their points rather than just being given.

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Adjustments patch (18)


[Weapon] Staff of Life's Thorn Incantation technique mana usage has been increased from 16.6 to 20 per second

[Weapon] Staff of Life's Thorn Incantation technique will now regain mana from healing allies

[Weapon] Staff of Life's Solace technique's damage has been reduced from 55 to 50

[Weapon] Staff of Life's Solace technique will now regain mana from healing allies

HM Comment: i'm making these changes so that these techniques that focus away from healing benefit greater from loadouts that still focus around healing rather than being good on their own while also making the weapon more consistent between techniques.


[Weapon] Skateboard's max health penalty has been reduced from -50 to -25

[Weapon] Skateboard will now be required to do a trick to exceed minimum speed

[Weapon] Skateboard spray can charges have been reduced from 4 to 3

HM Comment: apparently the previous change didn't fix the weapon so i'm trying out a different approach


Invisibility will no longer hide invisibility effects

[Perk] Assassin's Gambit will now prevent invisibility effects from being visible while moving

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
@project-remix-updates

The Best Community/Developer Drop Ever

HM Comment: hii! we're hard at work on the major update and the new netcode/framework however i've been sick so i've been making these additions were made in my free time ^_^ if we like this vote and how it turned out, we may do another community designed weapon (this time in events) at some point!

The following weapon was created by a community vote for fun in #pr-general:
melee - very slow attacks - heavy damage - defensive/aoe m2 - lifesteal


Added a new Melee weapon: Berserker's Greatsword!

Previously bronze & brass of their own accord, the Redcliff Knights had unionized alongside the Astral Isles to defeat a greater enemy. This birthed the new age of the Redcliff - one not of magic - but of weaponizing the very essence of their enemies. Their weapons are now tarnished, but strengthened anew.
An enormous hefty greatsword imbued with strength to absorb your enemies' health
Attack after jumping to slash you and your enemies upward, additionally marking those enemies to take increased knockback
+75 max health


[Weapon] Berserker's Greatsword comes with the following technique: Guillotine!

Slam your sword into the ground, inflicting Lifesteal on enemies while granting damage reduction to self and nearby allies
Lifesteal will heal you and allies for 40% of damage dealt


[Weapon] Berserker's Greatsword comes with the following technique: Immolation!

Secondary Fire will imbue your weapon with red flames for 4 seconds
Allows your blade to slice traveling red flames which will inflict Lifesteal and Burning onto enemies
Lifesteal will heal you and allies for 40% of damage dealt


[Weapon] Berserker's Greatsword will alter [Ability] Barbaric Roar into [Ability] Call of Valhalla!

Unleash a powerful war cry upon your enemies
Inflicts heavy damage and Lifesteal for 4 seconds to enemies within range while granting Enraged (+15% increased move speed) to self and nearby allies for 5 seconds
Additionally grants 25 overhealth for every nearby enemy (up to +400)


[Weapon] Magician's Tophat's Primary Fire has been reworked:

Primary Fire will draw 3 cards which will randomly depict if the card will inflict damage or grant healing when thrown

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Minor adjustment patch (1)


[Weapon] Greatsword's Immolation technique will now have infinite duration but will grant up to 5 charges

[Weapon] Greatsword's Immolation technique red flames will no longer be cleared from dropping your weapon

HM Comment: at first i wanted it to be a huge tradeoff to give the weapon a ranged attack, but i think people would rather just be able to use it at all


[Weapon] Magician's Tophat will no longer regain mana upon reaching 100% anti-heal buildup on an enemy

[Bugfix] [Ability] Ravenous Maul will now be properly placed on the [Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags bubble

[Bugfix] Fixed an issue where [Remix Ability] Marble Madness didn't rotate on specific weapons

[Bugfix] Adjusted the viewmodel for [Weapon] Fists' Super Slash Cat Claws skin

[Weapon] Skateboard skating will now increase step height by 300%

[Weapon] Slingshot's Tri-Shot technique has been given the Long Ranged category

[Remix Ability] Marble Madness will now have reduced size when pressing Crouch

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Slight QOL + Gamemode Adjustments (3)


[Weapon] Linked Sword's [Remix Ability] Holy Judgement ability alter will now have an additional unique visual for readability



[Weapon] Burst Rifle's Primary Fire spread has been reduced by 75%

HM Comment: combined with the smaller bullet size, the weapon's insane spread has given it sort of an RNG feel to its attacks. this shift should help it feel more consistent.


[Weapon] Slipknot's Primary Fire will now be queued to fire at 100% charge as soon as possible if Primary Fire is released past 75%

[Weapon] Atmoblaster X-4's Primary Fire will now be queued to fire at 100% charge as soon as possible if Primary Fire is released past 75%

HM Comment: see Slipknot's comment above ^^


[Weapon] Linked Sword's Royal Guard technique will now only grant damage resistance for attacks coming from the front

HM Comment: this should make the weapon feel less 'invincible' and allow for more sensical fights.


[Gamemode] King of the Hill new zone alert has been changed from 10 seconds to 15 seconds remaining

[Gamemode] King of the Hill will now show the next incoming zone before activating

[Gamemode] Fishin' for Flags has been disabled on [Map] Glass Houses

updates.threadTitle: The Best Community/Developer Drop Ever

updates.author: meal(HM) Team
updates.content:
Small adjustments patch (4)


[Weapon] Burst Rifle damage falloff range has been reduced from 80-160 to 60-120

HM Comment: the previous change to burst rifle made its range a little too far for comfort, so while the new weapon spread is better to play with, i'm adjusting its ranged capabilities.


[Weapon] Slingshot's Tri-Shot technique's primary fire will now fire a three round successive burst

HM Comment: i've wanted to make this change for a while now because i'd like it to be a bit more different than the other techniques, but i never got around to doing it until now. this addition should add more usage to the weapon's secondary fire while not making the technique entirely focused around it.


[Ability] Barbaric Roar can now be used even when Enraged if the Enraged source wasn't from the ability user

HM Comment: now the ability matches the power of the original ability without having the size/range increase like how it should

Adjustments patch (14)


[Weapon] Stellar Tune's Soothing Tune technique will now additionally heal the user for 50% the amount after hitting healing bullets on allies

HM Comment: soothing tune has been debated as the worst technique in the game, this should give it some extra survivability from something other than its slow area heal.


[Weapon] Grenade Launcher's Volatile Grenades secondary fire will no longer inflict Burning

HM Comment: burning was added so that it would have a use purpose outside of defense shred, but its damage is already incredible so i'm going to dial it back a bit


[Weapon] Casting Staff's Salem spell will no longer grant overhealth while weakened

[Weapon] Casting Staff's Polaris spell combo has been removed

[Weapon] Casting Staff's Moonbeam spell will no longer slow the user while casting

HM Comment: a lot of people have been asking for a casting staff nerf for about half a year now and i've had these changes in mind for a while, but because of the difficulty of the weapon i felt as though it needed salem's healing in order to not be a feeding death loop as its gameplay since other weapons can easily fire instantly while casting staff needs to charge spells. on top of that, polaris was added because people kept poking fun at the weapon back then for being categorized as long range but having no long range attacks, but now that the weapon is moved to the explosive category a bunch of patches ago, it doesn't need a consistent long range attack anymore. however, i will be giving moonbeam an extra boost so that it doesn't become considered a weak spell for its high tier placement again.


[Ability] Dash I cooldown has been decreased from 4.5-6 seconds to 4-5 seconds

[Ability] Dash II cooldown has been decreased from 4.5-6 seconds to 4-5 seconds

HM Comment: just a small shift to give dash more consistency and reliability, the current cooldowns are a bit much for what it does, plus there's a newer change below to counteract some of its power


[Perk] Bonus Health will no longer grant overhealth if the user was hit within 1.5 seconds

HM Comment: previously, bonus health considered the user to be 'out of combat' if passive regeneration was triggered, however this added an interaction where any ability that would trigger passive regeneration would additionally trigger bonus health, even during fights. this change should make it less powerful alongside those forms of healing/cleanse.


[EXPERIMENTAL] Remix Ability buildup will now be decreased by 12.5% for every slot equipped with an ability categorized as Movement or Verticality

HM Comment: for a while now, movement abilites have been completely reliable and the only way to survive or win. these changes should boost the power and capabilities of builds that don't, especially ones that have neither slot equipped as mobility which previously have been completely unviable.

hii, recently i've seen some people admit to purposely speaking in a way to humiliate me and make me feel like i'm stupid in order to get me to do balancing/development decisions. this is manipulative and sociopathic behavior and complete abuse to having a channel like suggestions or being able to have such close contact with a developer and his team who works without pay

from here on out, posts about nerfs/buffs/balancing in suggestions will be ignored and i will be only strictly reading ones about new weapons/abilities/remix abilities/perks/ect. or cosmetics. please be kind to your fellow community members, and please look forward to the new netcode/engine update

[Ability] Healing Orb shield size has been increased from 150% to 200%

[Ability] Healing Orb health has been increased from 125 to 200

[Ability] Backflight horizontal speed has been decreased from 50 to 40

[Remix Ability] Remote Airstrike will now additionally inflict DEFENSE SHRED for 6 seconds

updates.threadTitle: The Best Community/Developer Drop Ever

DEFENSE SHRED defense reduction has been increased from 50% to 65%

DEFENSE SHRED can no longer be cleansed

HM Comment: since defense shred was added to counteract mitigation/sustain builds, this change should counteract ones that also have sources of cleanse.


[Ability] Ley Lines will no longer restore MANA

[Ability] Ley Lines will no longer have a maximum health limit

HM Comment: damage/healing increases are already strong enough, mana recovery ruins the balance of some of the game's mana restricted weapons/mechanics. the health limit removal is because with the current state of the game, being locked in a single position is already punishable enough.


[Ability] Anti-Heal Potion charges has been increased from 1 to 2

[Ability] Anti-Heal Potion cooldown has been increased from 7.5 to 9.5 seconds

[Ability] Anti-Heal Potion anti-heal duration has been decreased from 2.75 to 2 seconds

HM Comment: there's been some discussion on whether anti-heal is useless or not, and i agree that it does its job effectively, but not against any sort of cleanse. this shift should give the user more opportunities to use it, but less impact over a fight's duration.


[Ability] Star Fragment's pull radius (now separate from explosion) has been reduced from 25 to 20

HM Comment: i think a lot of people get angry over star fragment because of its inescapable pull, but i never really thought it was all that powerful so i'm just going to be nerfing the pull by a small amount.


[Weapon] Slipknot's Primary Fire maximum arrow damage has been increased from 60-80 to 70-100

[Weapon] Laser Finger Pointers' Advanced Targeting damage laser will no longer increase spread

[Weapon] Casting Staff has been given a new combo spell: Polarity! (Combust -> Moonbeam)

HM Comment: after polaris was removed, a lot of people got really upset and wanted something new in place of it. here's a new spell combo that's a lot more counter-able than a oneshot combo aswell as a new way to lead players into casting staff's melee-ranged spell combos.


[Remix Ability] Soul Cleave trail duration has been decreased from 8 to 6 seconds

[Remix Ability] Stravant's Lightning duration has been decreased from 8 to 6 seconds

[Remix Ability] Stravant's Lightning damage has been increased from 150 to 175 per second

HM Comment: these remix abilities is incredibly annoying to fight having unnecessarily long durations compared to other remix abilities.


[Remix Ability] Blox Cards' Cami card will now inflict DEFENSE SHRED for 6 seconds

HM Comment: just another utility addition for a more rather lackluster attack
